tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas bshad pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa'i tho yig gi don 'grel 'dod dgu'i ljon shing rin po che'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bud+dhā sidhā ya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gsum mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid can// khams gsum 'gro la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// sa gsum smra ba'i seng ge'i zhabs la 'dud// sgrub thabs kun las btus sam rgya mtsho las// byung ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi ni// mngon rtogs rjes gnang cho gar bcas pa rnams// dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung bzhin bshad kyi nyon// mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ras phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa yar lung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'am rgya mtshor grags pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben par mchod stegs ji ltar 'tshams pa'i steng du mañji'i khar maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang gis thig le byas te/ thog mar rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum pa'i tshom bu 'bras sogs kyis dgod/ de'i mthar dbang ldan gyi gnas su mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri mchog byang du zhal zas/ shar mdun drang por rjes gnang du byed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i gtor ma/ zhal zas/ me tog spos/ gtor ma'i chab dang*/ mchod yon sogs kyi kha gso ba'i bum pa/ slob dpon gyi mdun du cog tse'i steng du ting shag ting 'bras nas sogs kyis bkang ba/ slob ma la bkye bsdu'i nas sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len ltar sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa dang dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ mdun bskyed sgrub cing mchod bstod gtor ma dbul ba dang*/

brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ rjes gnang ji ltar byed pa'i tshul dang*/ sgrub thabs so so'i mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bye brag tu bshad pa dang lnga'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa rnams oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā/ mthar rol mo dkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs lan gsum gyis byin dbab bo// bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig tsam brjod pa'i mthar/ thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum pa'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod pas sems bskyed do// ༈ (1) /rang skad cig gis thub pa rdo rje gdan du gsal ba'i snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor rnam pa gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drang*/ oṃ shākya mu ne sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ zhes sogs nas shab+da swā hā/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i zhes sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom mo// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod de rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las phung po'i bdud ser po/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud dmar po/ 'chi bdag gi bdud nag po/ lha'i bu'i bdud sngon po rnams kyi steng du seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje ser po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid thub pa rdo rje gdan sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum ngur smrig gsol zhing*/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byang bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ de'i g.yas su byams pa ser po g.yas rin po che'i rnga yab/ g.yon klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dkar po g.yas rin po che'i rnga yab/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs shing*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal la blta zhing bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dam tshig gsum bkod gtso 'khor gsum gyi rnam par oṃ sa mā dzaḥ

zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drang*/ de nyid la/ oṃ shākya mu ne sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drang*/ de la/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis sngar ltar mchod/ dbang gi lha la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa abhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang*/ byams pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can kyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūm̐ swā hā zhes pa brgya rtsa 'am nyer gcig sogs ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsam pa ni bdag bskyed do// gnyis pa ni/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las phung po'i bdud ser po zhes (ñja)sogs nas/ sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ ting shag brdung zhing*/ ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs sh+lo ka gsum gyis spyan drang*/

de la mchod pa/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang lha spyan drang pa nas rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa'i bar gong bzhin no// mchod pa bsang sbyang nas shab+da'i bar gyis gong ltar byin gyis brlab/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ ting shag brdung zhing*/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bstod/ de bar la mchod g.yog pas gtor ma chab kyis bran/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūm̐ swā hā'i mthar oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyi gtor ma phul/ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ ting shag brdung*/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes sogs kyis bstod/ gsum pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng bsam pa/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pas thugs rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing*/ gong ltar bzlas pa ci rigs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la sogs kyis gong ltar gsol ba gdab bo// bzhi pa rjes su gnang ba ji ltar byed pa'i tshul ni/ slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas gral la gnas pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes snyim pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang*/ 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod kyi snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/

de la'ang gsan rgyu'i dam pa'i chos ni ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshad med pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa de nyid kyis dang por byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed tshul dang*/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags tshul dang*/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po thugs bskyed tshul ni/ ston pa 'di dang po rdza mkhan gyi khye'ur gyur pa'i tshe sems dang po bskyed pa yin te/ bskal bzang las/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub de la// 'jam gang zhig ni dbul bar byas nas kyang*// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gnyis pa bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags tshul ni/ ston pa 'di gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro'i phung po la sogs pa du ma la/ grangs med dang po'i tshogs bsags pas sa dang po thob pa yin/ de nyid tshong dpon sher bzang du skru 'khrungs pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag la sogs pa du ma la grangs med gnyis pa'i tshogs bsags pas sa bdun pa thob pa yin/ yang de nyid gzhon nu sprin du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad la sogs pa du ma la grangs med gsum pa'i tshogs bsags pas sa brgyad pa thob pa yin te/ lung las/ gang tshe mar me mdzad kyis nga*// lung bstan gyur pa de yi tshe// sa brgyad pa ni thob gyur te// dbang bcu dag kyang thob par gyur// ces so// de nas bzung ste grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa bcu rdzogs pa yin no// gsum pa mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul ni/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ 'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs med du// sangs rgyas rnam par 'tshang mi rgya// gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du// 'dod chags bral khyod 'tshang rgya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

dang po gnas 'og min zhes kyang bya/ stug po bkod pa zhes bya ba'am/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gling chen po bzhi pa'i lho 'dzam bu'i gling du/ dus bskal pa bzang po 'di la tshul 'jig rten dang mthun par mdzad pa'i phyir srod la bar chad med pa'i lam gyis bdud btul/ tho rangs rnam par grol ba'i lam gyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas/ mdzad pa brgyad dang*/ bcu gnyis dang*/ bcu drug la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do// de lta bu'i 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang khams dang bag la nyal ba la sogs pa la dgongs nas chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa yin te/ de la'ang chos zhe bya ba 'di ci zhes rnam par rtog par gyur na/ chos zhes bya ba'i sgra ni rnam grangs du ma la 'jug ste/ rnam bshad rigs par/ chos ni shes bya lam dang ni// mya ngan 'das dang yid kyi yul// bsod nams tshe dang gsung rab dang*// 'byung 'gyur nges dang chos lugs la'o// zhes bcu la 'jug pa las/ 'dir chos lugs kyi gtam bya'o// chos lugs zhes bya ba ni ci yin zhe na/ rang rang gi thabs dang thabs las byung ba'i rnam par gzhag pa'i gzhung lugs te/ de la 'di ni blo 'chos pa'i phyir ram/ blo 'dul bar byed pa'i phyir chos zhes bya'o// dam pa ni mchog gam mi 'gyur bas na dam pa ste/ dam pa'i chos dang don gcig pa de la gsum ste/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gang la dmigs shing bsgrubs pas sgrib pa zad cing yon tan bskyed pa'i thabs su gyur pa ste/ sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad dang*// sgrib pa kun sel dam pa'i chos// zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin no// gnyis pa sgra don ni/ dharmāḥzhes pa dbyings sam 'dzin pa la 'jug pas/ gdul bya rnams ltung ba'am ngan 'gro las 'dzin pas chos so// yang dam pa'i chos ni dam pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos yin pa'am/

skyes bu dam pas dpyad par bya bas dam pa'i chos so// gsum pa dbye ba la gnyis las/ dang po brjod bya rjod byed kyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ mdzod du/ thub pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te// lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do// zhes rtogs pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ 'gog lam gyi bden pa gnyis kyi rang bzhin no// lung gi chos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rtogs pa'i chos la 'jug pa'i rjod byed de/ dbye na spros pa las byung ba'i bag chags dang*/ rgyu mthun las byung ba'i mngon brjod gnyis te/ dang po ni/ rta dang glang po la sogs pa 'jig rten dang mthun par brjod pa'o// gnyis pa rgyu mthun las byung ba'i mngon brjod ni/ brgyad stong 'grel chen snying po mchog las/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan dang*// tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang*// rtogs brjod de lta bu byung dang*// skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang*// rmad byung gtan la dbab pa'i sde// gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis so// zhes gsungs pa ltar gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis yin no// gnyis pa rgyu 'bras mchog dman gyi sgo nas dbye na/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis dus gsum du dbye ba las/ dang po 'bras bu'i chos ni/ sdug bsngal zhi ba'i myang 'das rnams yin no// gnyis pa sgrub pa'i chos ni myang 'das de thob byed kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa ste thar lam rnams yin no// gsum pa bshad pa'i chos la bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis las/ dang po bka' la gsum las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ brjod bya don dang ldan pa/ rjod byed chos dang 'brel ba/ byed las nyon mongs spong zhing 'bras bu thar pa'i phan yon ston pa'i rjod byed sangs rgyas kyi bdag rkyen las gtso bor byung ba ste/ rgyud bla mar/ gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing*// khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsung*// zhi ba'i phan yon ston par byed pa gang*// de ni drang srong gsung yin spyi bos blang*// zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no// gnyis pa sgra don ni/

su bha ṣi ta zhes pa legs par gsungs pas na/ bka'o zhes pa'i don yin no// gsum pa dbye ba la drug las/ dang po dus kyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ tha ma don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsum las/ dang po ni/ lung so sor thar pa/ bshad pa'i lung rnam 'byed/ lung gzhi/ phran tshegs/ gzhung bla ma la sogs pa rnams yin no// gnyis pa ni/ yum rgyas pa stong phrag brgya pa/ 'bring gi rgyas pa nyi khri lnga stong pa/ 'bring gi bsdus pa shes rab khri pa/ bsdus pa'i rgyas pa brgyad stong pa/ bsdus pa'i bsdus pa 'phags pa sdud pa la sogs pa mngon par rtogs pa'i don ston pa'i mdo dang*/ sher snying sogs snying po'i don ston pa rnams yin no// gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas phal po che dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa la sogs pa'i mdo rnams yin no// gnyis pa brjod bya'i sgo nas dbye ba la drang don dang*/ nges don gyi bka' gnyis te/ mdo gang kun rdzob rig pas brtags na sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa ston pa dang*/ don ma rig pas 'thad par ston pa dang*/ sgra ji bzhin pa ston pas te/ blo gros mi zad pa las/ kun rdzob sgrub pa ston pa ni drang pa'i don to// don dam sgrub pa ston pa ni nges pa'i don to// zhes so// yang chos 'khor dang po ni gdul bya nyan thos la gsungs pas drang don gtso che/ chos 'khor bar pa ni byang chub sems dpa' la gsungs pas nges don gtso che/ chos 'khor tha ma ni rigs can gsum ga la gsungs pas drang nges sna tshogs pa yod ces chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal snga nas gsung ngo*// gsum pa rjod byed kyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa rnams yin no// bzhi pa gnyen po'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/

mdo sde'i sde snod dang*/ 'dul ba'i sde snod dang*/ mngon pa'i sde snod dang gsum ste/ dang po mdo sde'i sde snod ni/ mdo sde dang*/ dbyangs bsnyad dang*/ lung bstan dang*/ ched brjod kyi sde dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa 'dul ba'i sde snod ni/ gleng gzhi'i sde'o// gsum pa mngon pa'i sde snod ni/ rtogs brjod dang*/ de lta bu byung ba dang*/ skyes pa rabs kyi sde dang gsum mo// mngon pa'i sde snod kyi bka' ni bye brag tu smra bas mngon pa sde bdun yin te/ min na sde snod gsum ma tshang bar 'gyur zer zhing*/ mdo sde pas de dgra bcom pa bdun gyis byas pas bka' ma yin mod/ mngon pa'i sde snod gzhan gnyis kyi nang du 'dus pas skyon med do// zhes so// gnyis pa ni mdzod las/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni// chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs// zhes gsungs pas/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ste/ 'dod chags la spyod pa'i gnyen por 'dul ba'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong*/ zhe sdang la spyod pa'i gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod= gti mug la spyod pa'i gnyen por mngon pa'i sde snod= dug gsum cha mnyam la spyod pa'i gnyen por gsang sngags kyi sde snod nyi khri chig stong rnams gsungs so// lnga pa gdul bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ nyan thos kyi sde snod dang*/ theg pa chen po'i sde snod gnyis gsungs so// drug pa bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye na/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka'/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' dang gsum las/ dang po zhal nas gsungs pa ni/ sdud pa po'i tshig ma 'dres pa 'phags pa sdud pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' la sku yis byin gyis brlabs pa sa bcu pa lta bu'o// gsung gis byin gyis brlabs pa ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba lta bu'o// thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa kun bzang gi spyod pa ston pa'i mdo lta bu'o// des yang thugs ting nge 'dzin dang*/

thugs rje dang bden stobs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa gsum du'ang rung gsung ngo*// gsum pa rjes su gnang ba'i bka' ni/ thog mar gleng gzhi dang*/ bar du mtshams sbyor ba'i tshig dang*/ mjug tu mthun 'gyur dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis chos yang dag par sdud pa sogs su gnang ba'o// gnyis pa bstan bcos la mtshan nyid ni/ rtsom pa po phyin ci log gi g.yeng ba med pas bka'i don bshad pa'i rjod byed ston pa lta bu'o// nges tshig ni/ shās+t+ra zhes pas 'chos pa dang*/ skyob pa ste/ nyon mongs pa gsum bslab pa gsum ldan du 'chos pa dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal las skyob pas na bstan bcos te/ rnam bshad rigs par/ nyon mongs dgra rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang*// ngan 'gro srid las skyob byed gang yin pa// 'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos te// gnyis po 'di dag gzhan gyi lugs la med// ces so// des na bstan bcos 'di ni bka' 'ang yin mod/ 'di ni dgongs 'grel gyi dbang du byas pa'o// dbye ba la bzhi las/ dang po mchog dman gyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ sa sde las/ don med don log don dang ldan// thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len dang*// ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spong*// bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod// ces pas don dang lnga nas/ sgrub pa lhur len pa/ duḥkha spong ba'i bstan bcos gsum mchog yin la/ gzhan rnams dman pa yin no// gnyis pa byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ tshig don rgya chen po sdud pa dang*/ zab mo rnam par 'byed pa/ 'khrugs pa go rim du bsdebs pa'i bstan bcos dang gsum yin no// gsum pa brjod bya'i sgo nas dbye ba la/ ji snyed pa ston pa'i bstan bcos shes rab brgya pa lta bu dang*/ ji lta ba ston pa'i bstan bcos mdo sde rgyan lta bu dang*/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa'i bstan bcos byang sa lta bu rnams yin no// bzhi pa bka'i sgo nas dbye ba la gnyis las/

dang po bka' spyi ni/ sgra dang tshad ma'i bstan bcos rnams yin no/ gnyis pa bye brag gi dgongs 'grel la gsum las/ dang po bka' dang po la lta ba'i cha ston pa ni/ chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus// gdags pa'i bstan bcos mau gal bus// khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos byas// rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis// ye shes la 'jug kāt+ya'i bus// rab tu byed ba dbyig bshes kyis// yang dag 'gro ba'i rnam grangs ni// gsus po che yis byas zhes grags// zhes pa'i mngon pa sde bdun dang*// mngon pa gong 'og rnams yin no// spyod pa'i cha ston pa/ mdo rtsa dang me tog phreng ba'i rgyud la sogs pa 'dul ba'i bstan bcos rnams yin no// gnyis pa bka' bar pa'i lta ba'i cha ston pa dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab dang*/ rig pa drug cu pa dang*/ stong nyid bdun cu pa/ rtsod pa bzlog pa/ zhib mo rnam 'thag tha snyad bsgrub pa ste rigs pa'i tshogs drug la sogs pa dang*/ spyod pa'i cha ston pa spyod 'jug gam/ bslab btus la sogs pa rnams so// gsum pa bka' tha ma'i lta ba'i cha ston pa/ 'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rgyan dang*/ mdo sde rgyan dang*/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed dang*/ chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed dang*/ rgyud bla ma ste byams chos lnga'i phyi ma bzhi lta bu dang*/ spyod pa'i cha ston pa sdom pa nyi shu pa la sogs pa'o// de lta bu'i bka' bstan bcos rnam dag rnams ni lung gi bstan pa yin te/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus// legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel pa// de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa ni// 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ spyi don gnyis pa gdul bya thun mong ma yin pa rnams la sngags kyi theg pa gsungs pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul ni/

slob dpon chen po shān+ti pas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang sngags kyi theg pa la don dam pa'i bden pa la khyad par med kyang*/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa la rgya che ba gsum gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ snang ba'i dmigs pa rnams lhar bsgoms pas dmigs pa rgya che ba dang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bde chen gyi dam tshig rnams yid bzhin du bzung bas byin rlabs khyad par can skye bas grogs rgya che ba dang*/ 'gro ba'i don du zhing yongs su dag pa da lta nyid nas spyod pas spyod pa rgya che ba gsum gyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir bzhed do// yang slob dpon dz+nyā na shrīs/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa 'di theg pa chen po dbu ma las khyad par ci zhig yod par bstan zhe na/ dmigs pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ ye shes dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ gdul bya ma lus pa rjes su 'dzin nus pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ byin gyis rlob pa myur ba dang*/ myur du 'byung ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa spong ba dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ spyod pa bla na med pa'i thabs mkhas pa ste/ rnam pa bcu gcig gis khyad par du 'phags so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ yang slob dpon ka ma la kri pa tis/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs pa 'di ni rtogs bya'i chos dbyings don dam pa'i bden pa spros pa dang bral bar gcig pa yin te/ de ma rtogs par 'tshang mi rgya bar mdo sngags gnyis ka mthun pa'i phyir/ thob bya'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas su mthun te spangs rtogs mthar thug pa la sangs rgyas su 'dod pa mdo sngags gnyis ka mthun pa'i phyir ro// 'o na thob bya'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas su gcig na gong du spangs rtogs la khyad par yod par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na skyon med de/

theg pa gsum gyi byang chub rigs gcig kyang spangs rtogs la khyad par yod pa bzhin no// thob byed kyi thabs byang chub kyi sems su mthun te/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i blo la kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems su mdo sngags gnyis ka mthun pa'i phyir te/ rtogs bya'i don gcig par bstan pa yin no// 'on kyang gang zag gi rgyud la skye bar byed pa'i thabs rnam pa bzhis khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul ni pha rol tu phyin par sa dang po ma thob bar du chos nyid don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa las med la/ rdo rje theg par ye shes dbab pa'am/ dbang gsum pa la sogs pa'i skabs su ye shes skye bas na/ don gyi ye shes spros pa dang bral ba mtshon par nus pa'i dpe'i ye shes rtogs pa yod pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos dang po yin no// pha rol tu phyin pa la yod pa'i thabs rnams kyi steng du zhi rgyas la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa dang*/ don dam zab mo dang*/ kun rdzob rgya che ba rtogs pa'i thabs bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs mang du yod pas khyad par 'phags chos gnyis pa yin no// pha rol tu phyin pa la mgo dang rkang lag gtong ba la sogs pa la ltos te tshegs che ba dang*/ gsang sngags pas spyod pa bde bas byang chub sgrub pa la sogs pa khyad par 'phags chos gsum pa yin no// pha rol tu phyin par gang zag dbang po rab kyis bskal ba grangs med gsum dang*/ 'bring gis bskal ba grangs med sum cu rtsa drug dang*/ tha mas bskal pa grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nas 'bras bu 'grub pa dang rdo rje theg par gang zag dbang po rab kyis tshe 'di nyid dang*/ 'bring gis 'chi kha'am bar do dang*/ tha mas skye ba bdun dang*/ shin tu tha mas kyang skye ba bcu drug na 'grub bar bshad pas khyad par du 'phags chos bzhi pa yin lags/

de lta bu'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i ming gi rnam grangs ni/ sngags kyi theg pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i theg pa rnams ming gi rnam grangs su bshad de/ slob dpon shrad+dhā ka ra warmas/ bla med kyi rgyud don la 'jug pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la'ang gnyis te/ sa dang pha rol byin pa'i theg pa dang*/ gsang sngags 'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa'o// zhes dang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// rdo rje la dga' rtag par gnas// des na sangs rgyas rnams kyis thabs// rdo rje theg pa zhes bshad do// zhes dang*/ 'grel chen dri med 'od las/ rdo rje 'di ni mi phyed pa dang mi chod pas chen po yin la/ de nyid theg pa chen po yin pas na rdo rje theg pa ste sngags kyi tshul dang*/ zhes ming gi rnam grangs de ltar du gnas pa yin no// rnam grangs de rnams kyi ming don bshad pa ni/ de la sngags zhes bya ba ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sngags rnams kyi ni mtshan nyid kyang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs yin te// chos kyi snying po sgrub byed cing*// chos kyi dbyings dang yang dag ldan// sngags kyi mtshan nyid yin par brjod// ces gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid la sngags zhes dang*/ lha rnams la'ang sngags zhes pa dang*/ lha rnams kyi mtshan nas 'bod pa la sngags zhes pa dang*/ snod ma yin pa la gsang bar bya ba la sngags zhes brjod pa yin/ 'di la'ang gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags gsum las/ dang po gsang sngags la gsang ba ni/ dpal kha sbyor gyi rab byed dang po las/ khyab 'jug dang*/ dbang phyug chen po dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i phyir gsang ba'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ sngags ni gong du bshad pa de rnams kyi don bsdu na/ mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa las yid rab tu skyob par byed pas na sngags te/

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las bshad do// dbang yon tan rim pa las ni/ sngags kyi sgra don ni/ stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa la bshad de/ ma ni stong pa mtshan ma bral// rdo rje sems dpa'i dbugs dbyung ba// shes rab chen po bdag gis bshad// tra ni skyob par byed pa'i don// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba// stong pa dang ni snying rje nyid// gnyis su med la gnyis kyi tshul// zhes gsungs pa ltar sngags kyi sgra la man+t+ra zhes bya ba 'byung la/ don bshad na man zhes pa ni yid yin la/ tra zhes pa ni skyob pa yin pas sgrub pa po'i yid mtshan rtog las skyob par byed ces pa'i don yin la/ tshul ji ltar du skyob na sngags kyi don thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa la 'jug pa las/ sngags bzlas pa dang*/ sgom pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud la stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bskyed pa'i tshul gyis ni gsang sngags zhes pa yin/ gnyis pa rigs sngags ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ 'dod chags mun pa rnams btul zhing*// nyon mongs rnams kyang rnam par 'dul// ma rig pa ni zlog byed pa// de ni rig sngags rnam par brjod// ces gsungs pas gtso cher skyon 'joms pa'i ldog pa nas rig sngags zhes pa'i don yin la/ gsum pa gzungs sngags ni/ yang de nyid las/ sangs rgyas chos rnams 'dzin byed cing*// chos rnams 'dzin par byed pa dang*// dge ba zhes pa 'dzin byed pa// gzungs sngags kyi ni mtshan nyid brjod// ces gsungs pas gtso cher yon tan 'dzin par byed pa'i ldog pa nas gzungs sngags zhes pa yin no// rdo rje ni don mang po la 'jug kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yin la/ theg pa ni 'dis 'dong bas na lam dang*/ 'dir 'dong bas na 'bras bu ste/ zhes pa'am/ yang na/ slob dpon shān+ti pas bshad pa ltar thabs shes zung du 'jug pa la byas shing*/

skabs 'dir 'bras bu'i theg pa ni/ 'bras bu 'grub pa la nye bas 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya ba'am/ da lta nas 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byas nas bsgoms pas na 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bzhag pa yin no// don de dang ldan pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde'i dbye ba la/ dang po rgyud sde gnyis su dbye ba ni/ bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang gsum la phyi dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud la nang gi rgyud du 'jog pa yin te/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ phyi nang dbye ba shes pa yis// rgyud sde'i dbye ba shes par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyi nang gi rgyud du 'dod pa ni/ slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ra la sogs pa bzhed pa yin no// gnyis pa rgyud sde gsum du dbye ba ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas// rgyud sde rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// zhes dang*/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya ba'i rgyud// de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i tshul// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ de nyid 'dus pa las/ snying po phyag rgya sngags rig pa// dum bu las bshad rang bya ba'am// sgrub pa 'di ni thams cad du// zhes gsungs pa'i thams cad du zhes pa'i 'bru gnon pa/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos/ de nyid snang chen du/ thams cad ces bya ba ni/ bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ gnyis ka'i rgyud rnams so// zhes gsungs pas dpung pa bzang po la sogs pa bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa gnyis ka'i rgyud dam/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang gsum du 'dod pa ni yo ga'i srol 'dzin grub chen kun dga' snying po dang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen la sogs pa rnams bzhed pa yin no// gsum pa rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba ni/

rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ dgod dang blta ba dag gis dang*// 'khyud dang de bzhin gnyis gnyis kyi// rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de dag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de dag la// zhes dang*/ sam+bu ṭa las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang*// dgod dang bltas pas 'khrig pa yi// srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir gnas// zhes gsungs pa'i don la phyi rol mu stegs byed la sogs pa'i spyod pa bzhi yod pas/ de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba ni/ 'dod chags can dbang phyug gi rjes su 'brangs nas 'dod chags chos su smra ba rjes su gzung ba'i phyir de dang rjes su thun pa'i spyod pa ston pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs/ zhe sdang can khyab 'jug gi rjes su 'brangs nas 'tshe ba chos su smra ba de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir de dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa ston pa spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs/ gti mug can tshangs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gtsang sbra chos su smra ba rjes su gzung ba'i phyir de dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa ston pa bya ba'i rgyud gsungs/ rkyen mnyam pa skabs thob kyis gsum ga'i rjes su 'brangs nas gsum ga chos su smra ba de dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa ston pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs te/ de dag dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa bstan pas 'jug par 'gyur la/ zhugs pa na thabs mkhas kyi rtsis bsgyur te bla na med pa'i byang chub la drang ba'i ched du rgyud sde bzhi gsungs pa yin no// gnyis pa sangs rgyas pa nyid la mtshan nyid kyi theg pa la grub mtha' bzhi yod pas/ de dang lung sgo bstun nas bskyed chog mi 'dra ba bzhis rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba ni/ nyan thos dbang po tha ma gnas ma bu pa dang*/

'bring nyi 'og bye brag tu smra ba gnyis/ phung po la gcig dang tha dad gang du'ang brjod du med pa'i bdag 'dod pa ltar/ bdag nyid dang ras bris gnyis ka ma yin pa'i ye shes sems dpa' 'dod pa bya ba'i rgyud gsungs pa dang*/ nyan thos rab kha che bye brag tu smra ba dang*/ mdo sde pa gnyis gzung ba'i yul rdul phran don dam pa dang*/ de 'dzin pa'i shes pa skad cig ma bden par 'dod pa ltar bdag dam tshig sems dpa' dang*/ mdun du ye shes sems dpa' gnyis ka 'dod pa spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs pa dang*/ 'phags pa rang sangs rgyas bdag kun rdzob tu gzung 'dzin gnyis ka yod kyang*/ don dam par gzung yul med par 'dzin pa'i shes pa skad cig ma bden par 'dod pa ltar/ bdag dam tshig sems dpa' la ye shes pa bcug nas slar ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs pa dang*/ theg pa chen po pa dag kun rdzob tu gzung 'dzin gnyis ka 'dod la/ don dam par gzung ba med pas der 'dzin pa med ces gzung 'dzin gnyis su med par 'dod pa ltar/ bdag dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bcug nas dam ye gnyis tha dad par mi 'dod pa rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs so// 'di ni ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pa bzhed do// zhes gsungs/ gsum pa 'dod khams kyi sems can la chags pa che 'bring bzhi yod pas de dag ma spangs kyang byang chub thob par bstan pa'i phyir rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa ni/ 'dod khams kyi lha gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa la bltas pa tsam gyis chags pas tshim pa yod la/ de tsam gyi bde ba snang ba bya ba'i rgyud gsungs/ 'phrul dga' ba la de'i steng du dgod pa tsam gyis chags pas tshim pa yod la/ de tsam gyi bde ba snang ba spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs/ dga' ldan pa dang 'thab bral ba la de'i steng du 'khyud pa dang lag bcangs tsam gyis chags pas tshim pa yod la/

de tsam gyi bde ba snang ba rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang*/ rgyal chen ris bzhi pa dang*/ mi rnams la de'i steng du dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi chags pas tshim pa yod la/ de tsam gyi bde ba snang ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs so// 'dod khams pa'i chags pa rigs bzhi po der nges pa'ang*/ mdzod las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang*// dgod dang bltas pas 'khrig pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rgyud sde bzhir nges pa'ang*/ he badz+ra las/ dgod dang blta ba sogs dang*/ sam+bu ta las/ dgod dang blta ba lag bcangs dang*// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yin no// gnyis pa rgyud sde de dag grangs dang go rim gnyis ka nges pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// ces sogs gsungs pa ltar/ gang zag dman pa phyi lus ngag gi bya ba khrus dang gtsang sbra la dga' ba rnams la bya ba'i rgyud rnams bstan/ gang zag 'bring phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang*/ nang ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam du spyod pa rnams la spyod pa'i rgyud rnams bstan/ gang zag mchog ting nge 'dzin kho na la gtso bor spyod pa rnams la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams bstan/ gang zag ches mchog tu gyur ba nang ting nge 'dzin khyad par gong na med pa la spyod pa rnams la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams bstan pa yin pas/ grangs dang go rim de ltar du nges pa yin la/ gsum pa ming don ni/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor ston pas bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ phyi dang nang ting nge 'dzin gyi bya ba cha mnyam du spyod pas spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gong na med pa ston pas rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud ces bya ba yin no// bzhi pa rgyud sde lngar dbye ba ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/

bdag nyid lha'i snyems pa med pa dang*/ ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba med pa ni/ bya ba'i rgyud la zhugs so// zhes sogs kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ rdo rje sa 'og la sogs pa mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang*/ gsang ba spyi rgyud la sogs pa bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa gnyis ka'i rgyud dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de rnam pa lnga 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pa rnams bzhed pa yin no// lnga pa rgyud sde drug tu dbye ba ni/ bde mchog le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa dang*// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yis// sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa// de dang de la dga' ba yin// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas rdo rjes 'og la sogs pa mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud dang*/ gsang ba'i gsang ba ma'i rgyud mthar thug pa 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud de drug tu 'dod pa ni grub chen nā ro ta pa rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa bzhed pa yin no// de ltar na slob dpon kha cig gis brjod bya'i don phyogs rigs mthun pa la dgongs nas bsdu ba tsam mdzad pa yin la/ lnga dang drug tu 'dod pa'ang*/ chos kyi rnam grangs tsam ston pa dang*/ bshad bya'i chos kyi che ba dbyung ba'i phyir logs su smros pa yin gyis don la rgyud sde bzhir nges te/ rgyud kyis gdul bya bzhir nges pa dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi la dbang gi babs mi 'dra ba bzhi yod cing*/ de rnams dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lam gyi babs mi 'dra ba bzhir nges pa'i phyir te/ de la'ang bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud do// de rnams la'ang*/

rdo rje rtse mo las/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam// sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces dang*/ sam+bu ṭa las/ dbang dang bka' gnang thob nas ni// zhes gsungs pa ltar smin byed gyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ de thob nas ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren par byed pas rjes su gnang ba dang byin gyis brlabs pa rnams yin/ ye shes dngos su skyed par byed pa grol byed kyi lam rim pa gnyis bsgoms pa la sogs pa dang*/ de'i 'bras bu sku dang ye shes dang mdzad pa phrin las bcas pas bsdus pa las/ dbang gis smin cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams la yon tan ma skyes pa bskyed pa'am/ skyes zin mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i don du byin rlabs dang rjes gnang gnyis las/ de'i nang nas ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren par byed pa rjes su gnang ba ston par byed pa yin cing*/ de'ang rgyud sde rnams nas las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor tshul mi 'dra ba du ma zhig gsungs pa rnams 'phags yul gyi grub chen dang paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes shing*/ sgrub pa'i thabs rgyas bsdus sna tshogs mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs kun las btus pa rnams la/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ dang po rgyas pa ni/ slob dpon chen po a bha yas phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/ yar lung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs rgya mtshor grags pa 'di la rjes gnang dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi las/ rjes gnang yang nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi dgos sam snyam na/ de ni mi dgos te/ sgrub thabs 'di rnams kyang lha dang*/ sku mdog dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ sngags rnams gcig na sgrub thabs mang po la'ang rjes gnang gcig gis chog la/ lha dang sku mdog phyag mtshan mi gcig na sngags gcig kyang rjes gnang so sor byed dgos te/ gshed dmar dang dgra nag bzhin no// de bzhin du sngags mi gcig na lha dang sku mdog zhal phyag gcig kyang rjes gnang so sor dgos te/

spyan ras gzigs ha la ha la bzhin nam/ sher phyin ser mo phyag gnyis ma bzhin no// rjes gnang mi dgos pa'i sgrub thabs dang gzungs la sogs pa bco brgyad yod/ kun dril bas nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe gnyis dang*/ rigs mthun phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pas rjes gnang brgya dang bzhi bcu tsam yod pa ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba yin no// gnyis pa 'bring po ni/ pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags pas bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs phyed dang nyis brgya pa gcig yod de/ gzhung 'gyur ba tsam ma gtogs lung dang rjes gnang ni deng sang chad nas med cing*/ rgya gzhung 'di'i mgo na dkon mchog gsum rjes dran yod gsungs pa dang bcas pa rnams yin no// gsum pa bsdus pa ni/ bla ma ba ri lo tsā bas/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung dang*/ brda byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ shī la ka ra dang*/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta dang lnga la zhus nas bod du bsgyur ba sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'am/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa sgrub thabs dgu bcu go gnyis la/ rigs mthun rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pas rjes gnang bdun cu don dgu tsam yod pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs pa la sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa yin la/ da lan 'dir sgrub thabs rgya mtshor grags pa'i bstan bcos chen po nas 'byung ba zhi rgyas dbang drag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i yi dam gyi lha khyad par can rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la dang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ lus ngag yid gsum ma 'tshubs pas brtan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang ldan pas dul ba/ rig pa dang rig pa ma yin pa gsal bas blo gros gsal ba/ slob ma'i bya ba la khro ba bzlog pas bzod pa/

drang ba ni bsgrub pa'i ngos nas bstan la/ g.yo sgyu ni dgag pa'i ngos nas te/ de'ang g.yo ni bdag gi nyes pa 'chab pa'i thabs su sems gya gyur gyur pa'o// sgyu ni gzhan bslu ba'i bsam pas yang dag pa ma yin pa'i don ston pa'o// de gnyis gang la med pa ni drang ba ste/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan// bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med// ces pa thun mong gi mtshan nyid yin/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid ni/ zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i sngags kyi sbyor ba dang*/ mtha' drug tshul bzhi la sogs pa'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba dang*/ snying rjer ldan zhing bka' dang bstan bcos kyi don la mkhas pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon la nye bar mkho ba'i de nyid bcu dang*/ cho ga'i de nyid bcu dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi de nyid bcu ste de nyid sum cu shes shing bsnyen pa nas gzengs bstod kyi bar gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas pa dang*/ gdul bya dbang po rab 'bring tha ma rnams la sngags bshad pa'i spyod pa shes pa ste/ sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes// snying rjer ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas// de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes// dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas// sngags bshad pa yi spyod pa shes// rab tu dang zhing dbang po dul// zhes gsungs pa ltar dang*/ bye brag tu yi dam lha'i bsnyen pa de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang*/ 'di rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba thob cing slob ma la ston nus pa zhig dgos pa yin no// gang la bya ba slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ slob ma mtshan nyid mi ldan pa la bstan na/ rang gzhan gnyis ka nyams par 'gyur bas/ zab mo'i snod du rung ba la slob ma'ang brtag dgos te/ slob ma gang sems can kun la mnar sems pas snying rje med pa khros pa'i 'og tu sems 'dud par 'dzin pas gdug pa/ nga rgyal bdun gyis khengs shing rang gi phun sum tshogs pa dag la dga' ba'i sems 'dzin pas na chags pa/

nyon mongs pa las sems mi bsrung zhing bag med cing lus kyi spyod pa ma bsdams pas bya ba thams cad rang gi don du byed pas na spyoms pa dang bcas pa ste/ ji skad du/ blo ldan bla mas slob ma ni// snying rje med cing khro la gdug /khengs shing chags la ma bsdams dang*// spyoms dang bcas pa'ang mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa de lta bu'i slob ma la zab mo'i chos rnams mi bstan no// de bas na/ dpon slob kyi 'brel brtag pa shin tu'ang gces te/ ji skad du/ bla ma dang ni slob ma dag /mtshungs par dam tshig nyams gyur pas// dpa' bos dang por slob dpon dang*// slob ma'i 'brel pa brtag par bya// zhes so// 'o na bstan par bya ba'i slob ma gang zhe na/ blo brtan zhing spyod lam dul la snying rje che ba/ dkon mchog la dad pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa/ bzod bsran che la ser sna chung zhing bslab bya la mos pa/ bla ma dang yi dam la mos pa dang*/ bye brag tu rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba la sogs pa don du gnyer zhing dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom tshul bzhin du byed pa bsten dgos pa yin la/ gang du bya ba'i gnas la spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ dbang mdor bstan las/ gang na sa skyong chos ldan zhing*// gang zhig kho nar skye rgu rnams// bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa'i// gnas der rnal 'byor brtsam par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong zhing phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med pa dgos la/ khyad par du spyi rgyud las/ mchod rten chen po nyams dga' dang*// dben pa yi ni gnas dag dang*// ri yi rtse mo rgya chen du// dngos grub dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes dang*/ yang rtsa ba'i rgyud brtags pa gnyis pa las/ tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i khyim dang ni// dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du yang*// zhes bya ba la sogs pa ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/

rang ngam bla ma gong mas byin gyis brlabs shing*/ snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben zhing bkra shis pa'i gnas shig tu bya dgos par bshad pa yin no// nam bya ba'i dus ni/ spyi rgyud las/ nyi ma zla ba gzas zin dang*// ya mtshan che ltas byung ba dang*// cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la// zhes gsungs la/ zla ba so so'i yang ngo'i tshes grangs gnyis dang bzhi dang drug dang dgu dang bcu gnyis dang*/ lnga ma gtogs pa'i nyi ma bcu ni mchog tu bsngags shing*/ phur bu dang ni zla ba dang*// pa ba sangs dang nyi ma bzang*// zhes dang*/ rgyal dang skag dang sa ga dang*// me bzhi nag pa tha skar dang*// snron dang sog pa de dag ni// dkyil 'khor dag la rab tu bsngags// zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi gza' dang skar ma dang sbyor ba dang*/ byed pa bzang po rnams 'dzoms pa'i yar gyi ngo'am de rnams lhag par 'dzom na mar ngo la'ang nyes pa med de/ mar gyi ngo yi dus mtshams la// dkyil 'khor bri ba nyes pa med// ces gsungs shing*/ yang rab gnas kyi rgyud las kyang*/ dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas nyid// yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya// gza' dang skar ma 'dzom gyur na// mar gyi ngo la'ang nyes pa med// ces 'byung ba yin no// de dag ma brtags par ngan pa la las byas pa'i nyes pa'ang spyi rgyud las/ tshes grangs ngan dang dus min dang*// gnas min cho ga mi ldan par// mkhas pas dkyil 'khor mi 'bri'o// bris na dogs pa med par 'chi// zhes bshad la/ nges par brtag dgos pa'ang de nyid las/ de lta bas na yud tsam dang*// tshes grangs rgyu skar byed pa dang*// rmi lam bzang po brtag par bya// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don tshes grangs sogs bzang po 'dzom pa'i nyin bya bar bshad pa yin no// tshul ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga la/ sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa/

bdag bskyed bzlas pa bya ba/ mdun bskyed kyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du yi dam gyi lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa dang*/ de la mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma dbul ba dang*/ thugs rgyud bskul bar bya ba'i phyir du bzlas pa yun ring du bya dgos pa yin pas/ de dag sngon du legs par grub zin nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma la bya ba la/ rjes su gnang ba'i sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes rnam pa gsum las/ dang po la maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ rgyud dag par bya ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar mchod g.yog pas maṇ+ḍal bskul ba sogs grub nas/ phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// brtse chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyis// ma lus rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor rnam pa gsum la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung chen po 'thibs pa bzhin mngon sum lta bu bzhugs par mos pa byas/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum nas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin la/ dngos gzhi la// sku'i= gsung gi= thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba dang gsum yod pa las/ thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la thub pa rdo rje gdan dngos yin snyam pa'i sems kyis mos gus drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyi ma shar ba lta bu 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched gzung 'dzin tha mal du 'dzin pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur par mos/ de nyid la slob dpon gyis dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ zhes pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu stong pa nyid du sangs kyis sbyangs par mos pa byas/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dbyings su phung po'i bdud ser po sogs (3/4)nas gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar bdag bskyed nas 'byung ba ltar/ (3/3)hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal lam gyis btab nas/ slob dpon la khyed rnams kyis bsgoms pa lta bu'i thub pa rdo rje gdan dngos yin snyam pa'i yid kyis gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/

thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor rnam pa gsum gyi sku tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la thim par mos pa byas/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas kyang thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam tshad med grangs med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga dbang po'i sgo la sogs pa rnams na mar mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar sku lus la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ rol mo bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūm̐ swā hā'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā we shā ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes yang yang brjod cing gnyis su med par bstim/ de ltar na thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyis skye ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ de la brten nas sku bsgoms pa dang sku'i phrin las mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon thub pa rdo rje gdan du gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal bar dmigs/ khyed rang rnams thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi sku can du gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gser btso ma'i mdog can du gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ zhal nas thon/

khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos pa byas te/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces brjod la/ sngags lan gsum brjod mthar/ de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyun byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos pa byas te/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis me tog gi phreng ba phul ba de nyid slob dpon gyis sngags kyi phreng ba'i rang bzhin du byas te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig de ltar na thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor rnams kyi gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngag gis skye ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor rnams kyi gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ de la brten nas gsung bzlas pa dang gsung gi phrin las mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon thub pa rdo rje gdan du gsal ba'i zhal nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dngos po med pas sgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// bsgom pa'ang dmigs su med pa'o// zhes gsungs te/

de'i don khyed rang rnams lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa can snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu de nyid la yid cher gyis gtad pa la brten nas 'khor rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim zhing*/ rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i tshul can du ltems kyis zhu ste thugs ka'i sa bon la thim zhing*/ sa bon de'ang je chung je phrar gyur te/ mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du rang yal du yal gyis yal ba la brten nas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'i mtshan nyid can khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la skyes par mos pa mdzod/ spro na me tog gtor te/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs dang*/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ de ltar na thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi yid kyis skye ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ de la brten nas thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bsgom pa dang*/ thugs kyi phrin las mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas zhes brjod la/ rgya gzhung gi thog mar dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sgrub thabs gnyis po 'di la lung ma gtogs rjes gnang med/ lung rkyang gis chog go /thub pa rdo rjes gdan gtso 'khor gsum gyi sgrub thabs gsum yod pa'i lung bya/ rjes gnang gnyis pa la sgrub thabs du yod kyi lung yang 'dir bklags la/ tshom bu la mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/

mchod bstod dang*/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can sogs kyis gong ltar 'dod don zhu/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes mtheb srin gyis se gol byas pas/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsams la/ las kyi rdo rjes tshom bu rnying pa rnams bsdus te gsar pa dgod/ mchod pa rnams kha gso/ gtor ma gsar pa bsham/ de'i bar la slob dpon gyis skyabs 'gro sogs nas mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i bar gyis spyi'i chings thams cad gong bzhin las/ khyad par lha'i gdan/ sa bon/ gtso 'khor du yod/ rigs bdag sngags dang*/ mchod pa'i sngon gyi mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams so sor sbyor tshul ma 'dres par shes par byas la nyams su blang ngo*// rjes gnang ni/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sog

(6) sa nas/ ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la rigs du ma zhig yod pa'i nang nas 'dir 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhus la dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom bgyi'o snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa nas thugs kyi rjes gnang gi bar sngar gyi rigs 'gros sbyar la bya/ slar yang rjes gnang phyi ma'i sgrub thabs du yod kyi lung bya ba sogs go rim thams cad sngar bzhin las/ chos thun re re zhing yang rjes gnang dang po la gsol 'debs rgyun bshags sogs rgyas par bya zhing*/ rjes gnang phyi ma'i tshe 'das gtor gyi lhag ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas mgron dgug nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ sngags de nyid kyi mthar oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul la/ ting shag brdung*/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// chos don bden pa la gnas nas// zhi zhing dul ba'i sems su mdzod// bdag kyang byang chub ma thob par// gegs med bar chad med pa dang*// dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la// byang chub thob pa'i grogs kyang mdzod// ces pas phrin las gzhol/ mtheb srin gyi se gol dang*/ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes pas 'jig rten pa'i mgron gshegs su gsol la/ mdun bskyed brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya/ de nas rjes gnang phyi ma'i mthar/ gsum pa rjes ni/ mdor na de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ rjes gnang rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/

de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ lus longs spyod la sogs pa'ang slob dpon la drin lan du 'bul na cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang*/ zhes sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas 'byung ba'i thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum sogs kyi rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// sogs brjod nas slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo*// slob dpon gyis rjes chog gong du bstan pa ltar bya zhing rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung bar bya/ ting shag brdungs shing me tog gtor te/ che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med// sogs kyi bkra shis smon lam rgyas par bya'o// lnga pa sgrub thabs so so'i mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs kyi skor la/ ༈ (2) /'jig rten dbang phyug yi ge drug pa dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rtog pa nas bshad pa'i gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ spyi 'gro rnams ngos zin par byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can kyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas bgrang phreng dang*/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas phyogs su pad+ma'i steng du nor bu 'dzin pa dang*/ g.yon du pad+ma'i steng du 'bru drug ma gnyis sku mdog dang cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs par bskyed/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ kye nor bu pad+ma

ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ mtshan sngags lo ke shwa ra/ bstod pa/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan can// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'o// ༈ (3) /za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo nas bshad pa'i yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje dang pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'jig rten dbang phyag sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas bgrang phreng dang*/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dang nor bu 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs mnabs pa/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams 'dra'o// ༈ (4) /'jig rten mgon po pad+ma kha 'byed kyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'jig rten mgon po zhi ba sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yon pas pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag gnyis khu tshur bcings nas/ gung mo pad+ma kha ma bye ba lta bu/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams gong ltar ro// ༈ (5) /yi ge drug pa gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i steng du hrīḥlas rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug ni gong ltar bskyed/ de'i g.yas su nor bu 'dzin pa phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas nor bu dang*/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ g.yon du 'bru drug ma phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas pusti dang g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gzhan gtso bo dang mtshungs/

rigs bdag sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams 'dra'o// ༈ (6) /rnam snang mngon byang nas bshad pa'i kha sar+pā ṇi'i sgrub thabs bzhi la/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'jig rten dbang phyug kha sar+pā ṇi sku mdog dkar po zhal 'dzum zhing lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon sdong bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma bsnams pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ 'od zer dkar po dang ldan pa/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas logs su sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal 'dzin pa/ nor bzang ser po thal mo sbyar nas chos kyi ka pā la 'dzin pa/ g.yon logs su khro gnyer can ser mo g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon dbyug gu gsum pa 'dzin pa/ rta mgrin dmar po g.yas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon dbyug pa oṃ tshugs su byas pa/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ lo ke shwa ra kha sar+pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa/ mtshan dpe'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku// ston ka'i zla ba 'bum phrag 'khrigs pa'i gzi// rin chen bye ba'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (7) /mkha' spyod 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor bcu gsum pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas mkha' spyod 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal 'dzum zhing lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sogs nas/ oṃ tshugs su byas pa'i bar gong ltar bskyed la/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa/

mer spyan ma/ bden bral du mā ma kī/ rlung du gos dkar mo/ dbang ldan du dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ rigs bdag sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams snga ma dang 'dra'o// ༈ (8) /'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs bzhi la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las seng ge dkar po mgo bo g.yas su bstan zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa ral pa dmar po thur la 'phyang zhing*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ seng ge sgra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya pus mo g.yas kyi steng du brkyangs pa/ g.yon sku rgyab tu gdan la brten pa/ ral pa'i thor cog bcings shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas logs su sku la cung zad ma reg pa'i tri shū la ljang gu gyen du bsgrengs pa la sbrul dkar pos dkris pa/ g.yon logs su pad+ma dkar po'i steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs pas bkang ba'i thod pa dkar po can/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ tshangs skud ma gtogs rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dbu'i steng du rnam par snang mdzad/ dpung pa g.yas par mi bskyod pa/ g.yon par 'od dpag med/ dku g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan/ g.yon par don yod grub pa rnams bzhugs par gyur/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ āḥhrīḥsingha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ phyag 'tshal lo dkon mchog gsum la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/

phyag 'tshal lo 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la/ na maḥ.ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ byang chub sems dpa'/ bo dhi satwā ya/ chen po sems dpa'/ ma hā satwā ya/ snying rje chen po'i sku/ ma hā kā ru ṇ-i kā ya/ 'di lta ste tad+ya thā/ oṃ kun nas gso ba la myur ba'am rno ba ste/ a ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ rnam par gso ba'am khyad par gso ba/ nges par gso ba'am sgrub pa po dang nye ba'o/ ni ka ṭai/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe/ shin tu'ang gso ba'o/ byed pa drag po/ ka ro ṭe/ drag po gso bar byed pa/ ka ro ṭa/ brtson 'grus bīr+ye swāhā/ gzhi tshugs/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya singha nā da/ bstod pa skyon gyis ma gos sogs so/ /ka ṭa phongs pa/ krits+tsha dbul ba/ dza wa ne 'tsho ba'am gso ba'o// mchan bur bshad pa'i sngags 'di rgya gzhung gi sgrub thabs rnams na mi 'dug cing gsung rgyun la'ang med do// ༈ (9) /'jig rten dbang phyug ha la ha la zhal gsum phyag drug pa gtso 'khor gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug ha la ha la sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dkar po/ g.yas zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa na bgrang phreng*/ gsum pa na mda'/ g.yon gyi dang pos rang gi pus mo'i steng na gnas pa'i 'dod pa'i lha mo'i nu ma/ gnyis pa na pad dkar gyi sdong bu yal ga gsum pa/ gsum pa na gzhu bsnams pa/ brla g.yon pa'i steng du lha mo sgeg mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yon pas chu skyes 'dzin pa/ g.yas pas bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/

rin po che'i rgyan dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yas ngos su sbrul gyis dkris pa'i rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon du me tog gis bkang ba'i thod pa pad+ma'i steng na gnas pa/ rin po che'i ri'i phug na rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ badz+ra dharmāḥhrīḥ mtshan sngags oṃ lo ke shwa ra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (10) /'jig rten dbang phyug ha la ha la zhal gsum phyag drug pa gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po sogs yum med pa'i gtso rkyang bskyed/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ ha la ha la hrīḥ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (11) /rdo rje chos dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug gi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i ri'i phug tu pad+ma dmar po'i steng du hrīḥ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ rdo rje chos kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje chos sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba lta bu zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba sogs nas mda' 'dzin pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ g.yon gyi dang po na pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu/ gnyis pa na rang gi pus mo'i steng na gnas pa'i 'dod pa'i lha mo'i nu ma/ gsum pa na gzhu 'dzin pa sogs nas bzhugs pa bar gong ltar bskyed/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ badz+ra dharmāḥhrīḥ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra dharmāḥ bstod pa/ 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi sku// kun rtogs ye shes rdo rje'i gsung*// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la// zhes so// ༈ (12) /pad+ma gar dbang dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor dgu'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/

thugs rje byin rlabs rnams tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon pas rang 'dra'i yum gos dkar mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis pad+ma dmar po 'dzin cing g.yas pas de'i kha 'byed pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du rnam gzigs ma dkar mo g.yon pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa/ lhor sgrol ma ljang gu g.yon pad+ma ljang gu/ nub tu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma ser mo g.yon ut+pal sngon po/ byang du khro gnyer can ma dkar mo g.yon pad+ma ser po/ byang shar du pad+ma'i gnas can ma ser mo g.yon pad+ma dmar po/ shar lhor pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma sngon mo g.yon pad+ma dkar po/ lho nub tu sna tshogs pad+ma dkar mo g.yon pad+ma sngon po/ nub byang du sna tshogs rdo rje ma sna tshogs mdog g.yon sna tshogs pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyi phyag g.yas pas g.yon gyi pad+ma rnams kyi kha 'byed pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ hrīḥpad+ma nirte shra pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ra hūm̐/ mtshan sngags oṃ pad+ma nirte shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa/ gang gi rang bzhin chags bral yang*// chags pa can la chags pa dang*// mthun par bstan pas chags sogs rnams// zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (13) /pad+ma gar dbang zhal gcig phyag bco brgyad pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ gyur pa las zhes pa'i bar gong ltar las/ rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bco brgyad pa/ phyag thams cad kyis sna tshogs pad+ma re re bsnams pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/

skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ g.yas logs su sgrol ma dang nor bzang*/ g.yon logs su khro gnyer can dang rta mgrin te thams cad kyang lha'i rgyan dang*/ gos kyis brgyan pa/ rigs bdag sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams 'dra'o// ༈ (14) /'jig rten dbang phyug ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las mam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu brdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum dmar po ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du pam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum gyis= de'i steng du sum̐ las rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin gyi ri rab lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon pa/ sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa g.yas kyi dang pos sangs rgyas rnams dpang por gsol ba/ gnyis pa na phreng ba/ gsum pas ngan song na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la dge ba ston pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na dbyug pa/ gnyis pa na ri dwags nag po'i pags pa/ gsum pa na ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ hrīḥhūm̐/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ha ri ha ri ha ri bā ha na de bha wa/ bstod pa skyon gyis ma gos sogs so// ༈ (15) khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs dmar po gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las lug gnyis zhags pas sbrel ba'i steng du pad+ma dmar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i zhags pa/ g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa ral pa'i cod pan can/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sprul pa sna tshogs pa 'phro zhing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis dbang bskur ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mchod pa byed pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ bde byed dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis gar dang sil snyan rdung dkrol byed pa/ 'byung po'i tshogs mi'i mgo bo dang*/ keng rus la sogs pas brgyan pa du mas gdugs dang rnga yab la sogs pa du mas bkur sti byed pa'i tshogs du mas bskor ba/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ yam̐/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ trai lo kya ba shi ka ra lo ke shwa ra/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa dmigs bsal med pa rnams la spyi bstod 'dis bstod do// ༈ (16) /'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na zhags pa dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ na bza' dar dmar pos brgyan pa/ sku las 'od zer dmar po'i phreng ba 'phro ba/ sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ g.yas phyogs su sgrol ma dang*/ g.yon phyogs su khro gnyer can te gnyis ka'ang bzhad pa/

rigs bdag gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags/ oṃ tsi ṭi tsi na ṭi/ bi klo li bi klo li/ ma mā sā dha na pā ri wā ram+me ba sha mā na ya swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ o rak+ta lo ke shwa ra/ bstod pa skyon gyis ma gos sogs so// ༈ (17) /'jig rten gsum lhag par dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas skyes pa'i pad+ma dmar po'i steng du oṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa/ g.yas pas gsal bar mdzad pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' can/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags/ oṃ hūm̐/ mtshan sngags oṃ lo ke shwa ra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (18) /'jig rten dbang phyug mgrin sngon can ser po'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du ri dwags kyi pags pa nag po'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥser po las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mgrin pa sngon po can/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas rin po che sna tshogs pas gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ dbu la zla ba phyed pa dang*/ sku la phreng ba sngon pos brgyan pa/ e na ya'i pags pa'i mchod phyir thogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs mnabs pa/ nor bu dang bcas pa'i sbrul mjug mgul pa'i logs gnyis su bcings nas mgo gyen du phyogs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ s+phu l̥ṃ gāṣ+ṭa ha sak+ṣa/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ nī la kāṇ+ṭha ār+ya a wa lo ke te shwa ra/

bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (19) /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rim pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nag po zhal lnga phyag bcu gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer zhes pa nas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog nag po zhal lnga pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal mthing nag g.yas su dkar ba dang dmar ba'i zhal gnyis/ g.yon du ser ba dang ljang ba'i zhal gnyis te/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na ḍa ma ru/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ rdo rje/ mda' rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa drug na sdigs mdzub/ thod pa/ pad+ma dmar po/ nor bu/ 'khor lo/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan zhing mi mgo rlon pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'/ dmigs bsal med pa rnams la rdor sems kyis rgyas gdab pa ni spyi 'gro zhes pa 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o// sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ i ti mu ni ba ra badz+ri hrīḥhūm̐ dzaḥ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ār+ya a wa la ke te shwa ra/ bstod pa/ gang gi rang bzhin khro bral yang*// khro ba can la khro ba dang*// mthun par bstan pas khro sogs rnams// zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /pad+ma'i phyag gi gzungs dang*/ sran ma ma sha'i gzungs la rjes gnang mi dgos lung gis chog go/ ༈ (20) /don zhags dkar po gtso 'khor lnga pa'i sgrub thabs ni/

stong pa'i ngang las rgya mtsho dang rin po che'i ri rab dang*/ pad+ma'i steng du byang chub kyi sems zhu ba las byung ba'i ā li kā li'i rang bzhin zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sbyar ba'i steng du hrīḥyig las skyes pa'i 'dam skyes kyi ze'u 'bru/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che'i ri'i phug na sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer zhes pa nas slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don yod zhags pa sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos mchod sbyin/ gnyis pas sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang mdzod 'dren pa/ gsum pa na nor bu'i phreng ba dkar po/ bzhi pa na mda'/ lnga pa na me'i dkyil 'khor/ drug pa na rin po che sna tshogs pa'i shing khri rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na pad+ma dmar po/ gnyis pa na ri rab/ gsum pa na rtse gsum/ gzhi pa na gzhu/ lnga pa na gser gyi ril ba spyi blugs/ drug pa na don yod pa'i 'bras bu bcings pa'i zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ mchod phyir thogs dkar po dang*/ 'od zer 'bar ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du pad zla'i steng du ha las don yod lcags kyu sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rgyan dmar po dang*/ rgya nag gi gos kyi bla gos mnabs pa/ g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las khro rgyal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na dbyugs pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dbu'i steng du rta mgo ljang gu/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang khro gnyer bsdus shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/

sbrul dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyab tu chu skyes dang nyi ma'i steng du ha las lha mo ral gcig ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang gri gug g.yon gnyis na ut+pal dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa dmar ser gcig tu 'khyil pa spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ sbrul dang 'dzam bu nā da'i dpal 'dzin pa/ glang po che'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ g.yon du chu skyes dang zla ba'i steng du ṭa las lha mo khro gnyer can sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na pad+ma dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gzhon nu dar la babs pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dkar po'i na bza' sku la gsol ba/ lha'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon pa'i bol gong la g.yas pa'i sor mo brten pa'i tshul gyis bzhengs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ
