'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ hrīḥtrai lo kya bi dza ya/ a don yod pa'i zhags pa/ mo gha pā sha so sor thogs pa med pa/ a pra ti ha ta hrīḥha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ a mo gha pā sha lo ke shwa ra/ bstod pa/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs so// ༈ (21) /'jig rten dbang phyug bhug+ma dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog ban+dhu ka lta bur dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pas chu skyes dmar po bsnams pa/ pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal mnga' ba/ ut+pal gyi 'dab ma ltar spyan gnyis dang ldan pa/ dbu skra gnag cing ring ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu/ 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mtshams rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ mer lāṃ las spyan ma dkar mo/ bden bral du māṃ las mā ma kī sngon mo/ rlung du pāṃ las gos dkar mo ser mo/ dbang ldan du tāṃ las sgrol ma ljang gu ste thams cad kyang phyag thal mo sbyar zhing pus mo sa la btsugs pa/ lang tsho gzhon nu dang ldan pa nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ sku smad rgyas shing zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag gong dang 'dra/ sngags oṃ hrīḥhūm̐/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya bhug+ma/ bstod pa/ sku mdog dmar po dang ser po rnams la/ sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags// yon tan dam pa kun gyi mdzod// spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan gsol ba// rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// 'di rnams la sgrub thabs sum cu so gcig dang gzungs gnyis dang bcas pa/

don zhags la/ gtso bo phyag bcu pa dang*/ phyag drug pa dang*/ phyag bzhi pa rnams kyis gtso byas pas sngar bzhin bya'o// gong gi pusti 'dzin pa'i sgrub thabs zhar la yod pa dang*/ sum cu rtsa lnga yod/ rjes gnang nyi shu yod do// ༈ (22) /'jam dbyangs kyi skor la/ brten pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du muḥdamar ser las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs brtan pa'i 'khor lo sku mdog gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mi shes pa gcod pa'i ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i pusti thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ ral pa'i zur phud g.yon du 'phyang pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ a ra pa tsa na muḥ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya mañju shrīḥs+thi ra tsakra/ bstod pa/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron me rab rgyas shing*// 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// rjes gnang gi bzlas lung gi skabs su slob dpon gyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar muḥdamar ser/ rtsibs brgyad la yi ge dang bcas pa gsal gdab/ rtsibs brgyad kyi bar mtshams brgyad du dbyangs yig gnyis gnyis te bcu drug mu khyud la kā li'i phreng ba dang bcas pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba la muḥ shar nas phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs la a ra pa tsa/ dbus su na/

mtshams bzhir me nas rim pa bzhin ni pra pan tsa/ bar mtshams brgyad du dbyangs yig gnyis gnyis/ mu khyud la kā li'i phreng ba rnams gsal bar dmigs/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i muḥlas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i 'khor lo sngags dang bcas pa la thim/ de dang mnyam du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu gzhan gyis tshad gzung bar mi nus pa'i gzungs dang*/ blo gros dang*/ spobs pa la sogs pa thams cad zhal nas zhugs/ snying ga'i muḥ'akhor lo sngags dang bcas pa la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos/ sogs skabs 'di dang 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sogs 'jam dbyangs kun la spyi'i rigs 'gre ba sogs skabs thob dang sbyar bar bya'o// ༈ (23) /'jam dbyangs seng ge sgra lha bcu gcig gi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge sngon po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs seng ge sgra sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pas ut+pal bsnams pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas su sum̐ las nor bzang gzhon nu/ chos thams cad pusti mchan nas bzung ste thal mo sbyar ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi cod pan gyis mdzes par byas pa/ g.yon du hūm̐ las gshin rje'i gshed nag po zhal 'jigs shing tho ba 'dzin pa/ skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ gzhan yang g.yas su nyi ma/ g.yon du zla ba/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa/ mer spyan ma/ bden bral du mā ma kī/ rlung du gos dkar mo/ dbang ldan du sgrol ma/

rigs bdag 'dra/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug oṃ dharmā dhā tu wā gī shwa ri muḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (24) /dpal ldan ngag gi rgyal po dmar ser gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs gsum la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge sngon po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thalhīṃ las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal ldan ngag gi rgyal po sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad de g.yas g.yon du gyes pa'i ut+pal sngon po re re 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog g.yon du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes par byas pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags/ wa ra ṇa saṃ do hā rā dza/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ba dī rā dza/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (25) /'jam dbyangs seng ge'i gdan can dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs ni/ seng ge sngon po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du muḥlas 'od zer sogs nas slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas ut+pal bsnams pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lngas brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs g.yas rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ wā gi shwa ri muḥ mtshan sngags/ oṃ mañju gho ṣa/ bstod pa 'dra'o//

༈ (26) /'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po gtso 'khor gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ seng ge sngon po sogs nas/ bdag nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag gi rgyal po sku mdog gser zhun ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis thugs khar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon ut+pal sngon po la gnas pa'i shes rab kyis pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' can/ cung zad 'dzum zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon mdun du khro bo gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi ngar gdong g.yon la brten zhing g.yon pas dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan zhing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gtso bo la zhal blta ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ gshin rje'i gshed la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ dharmāḥ chos dbyings ngag gam gsung gi dbang phyug dhā tu wā gī shwa ra muḥ mtshan sngags oṃ wā gi shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (27) /ngag gi rgyal po gser mdog can gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge sngon po sogs nas bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar snga ma ltar bskyed do// de'i g.yas su nor bzang gzhon nu dang*/ g.yon du gshin rje'i gshed/ rigs bdag gtso 'khor snga ma dang 'dra/ sngags oṃ wā gī shwa gsung gi dbang phyug ri muḥ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (28) /'jam dpal gyi rtog pa las gsungs pa'i ngag gi rgyal po gser mdog can gyi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge sngon po zhes pa nas bzhugs pa/

zhes pa'i bar snga ma ltar bskyed do// rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ mañju badz+ra hūm̐/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (30) /shes rab 'phel ba'i gter gi ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs ni/ gong gi dpal ldan ngag gi rgyal po dmar ser gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs gsum dang*/ rigs bdag gi bar 'dra/ sngags thalhīṃ/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (31) /'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dkar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang*/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi dang bcas pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i dbus su dhīḥyig dkar po sogs nas/ bdag nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thabs su gyur pa ma lus pa'i bstan bcos kyi pusti bsnams pa/ nor bu in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba'i ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar dmar po'i na bzas mdzes shing*/ pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab ma lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba/ gzhon nu'i tshul can/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar gyi steng du ra las drwa ba can/ rgyab tu pa las zla 'od/ g.yas su tsa las sgra can ma/ g.yon du na las nye ba'i sgra gcan ma ste/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ sku mdog dkar mo sogs gtso bo dang mtshungs so// bdag gi bla mas phyag len de ltar mdzad cing*/ rgya gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ a ra pa tsa smin par byed pa'i blo/ dhīḥ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa/ ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar glegs bam ral gris phyag mtshan pa// mchog gi blo gros rab mdzes zhi ba'i gzhon nu zur phud lnga// thar mchog dga' ba rgya chen pad+ma'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan yangs pa// blo gros ngan pa sreg mkhas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so//

༈ (31) /rje btsun 'jam dpal bsgom pa'i man ngag dang 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i a ra pa tsa na gnyis kyi sgrub thabs ni/ sku mdog dmar po ma gtogs snga ma dang 'dra'o// ༈ (32) /rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i man ngag yan lag med pa'i rdo rje zhal gcig phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ham̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid yan lag med pa'i rdo rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ dang po gnyis kyi ut+pal dmar po'i mde'u can gyi mda' dang*/ me tog gi gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang me long*/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis ut+pal sngon po dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga dmar po 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ mañju gho ṣa hrīḥdzaḥ mtshan sngags oṃ a naṅga mañju ghoṣa/ bstod pa/ gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs so// ༈ (33) /chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug dkar po'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po las 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ zhal thams cad dkar zhing phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na rdo rje/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhal re re la ut+pal ltar dkyus ring zhing rgyas pa'i spyan gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga g.yon gyi phyogs su 'phyang zhing*/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/

lha rdzas kyi gos dang rgyan dang sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam par snang mdzad/ sngags oṃ bud+dha lha lnga'i ngo bo rnam snang*/ rdo rje rnon po/ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa du sdug bsngal khats+tshe dā gcod pa/ pradz+nyā dz+nyā shes rab ye shes/ na murta ye/ lus dz+nyā na ye shes kā ya sku/ wā gsung gi gī shwa dbang phyug ra a mi bskyod pa/ ra pa tsa nā ya byed pa/ te na maḥ zhes bya ba/ yang na yi ge lnga po 'dis sdig pa sreg par byed ces pa'o/ mtshan sngags oṃdharmāḥdhā tu wā gī shwa ra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (34) /chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug dmar po'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hoḥdamar po las 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/

rdo rje rnon po sdug bsngal gcod// shes rab ye shes sku can te// ye shes sku can gsung dbang phyug /'gro ba smin byed khyod la 'dud/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ rtsa zhal dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ g.yas zhal gur gum ltar dmar ba/ rgyab zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ser/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa/ g.yas 'og ma gsum na zhags pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti/ rdo rje rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon 'og ma gsum na lcags kyu/ ral gri/ dril bu rnams 'dzin pa/ zhal re re la zhes pa nas nyams dang ldan pa/ zhags gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ ma hā rā ga badz+ra rā ga ya sarba satwa na ho/ mtshan sngags 'dra/ bstod pa gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs so// ༈ (35) /chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum pa'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du am̐ yig las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i steng du phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥmatshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (36) /a ra pa tsa na dang ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs gnyis ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥlas 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mi shes pa gcod par byed pa'i shes rab kyi ral gri dang*/

g.yon pas stong phrag brgya pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i lcang lo lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che lnga'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ban+dhu ka'i mdog lta bu'i na bza' zung gis spras pa/ sgeg cing mdzes pa'i 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag nges bsal med pa la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ sngags a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ mtshan sngags oṃ wā ka sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa ri bong 'dzin pa/ sogs so// ༈ (37) /'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub dkar po'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maṃ dkar po las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs dpa' bo grub pa sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pa la'i rtsa ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar 'dzin pa/ ut+pal ltar rgyas pa'i spyan gnyis dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga g.yon gyi phyogs su 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ gzhon nu lang tsho la bab pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ mañju badz+ra sid+dhi ka bī ra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (38) /ngag gi dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug rgyal po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas bklubs pa/ 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ wā gī shwa ri muḥ

zhes pa'am/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ wā ka sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs so// ༈ (39) /'jam dpal rgyal po rol pa dang 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las seṅge'i khri dang pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mam̐ ser po las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pus mo g.yas kyi ste du kha phub tu brkyangs shing*/ g.yon pas ut+pal sngon po'i yu ba thugs kar bzung zhing 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar bye ba/ gzhon nu zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dang sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ wā gī shwa ri muḥ mtshan sngags oṃ wā gī shwa ri/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (40) /'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub kyi sgrub thabs ni/ gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ sa bon dhīḥdang*/ sngags oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa duḥkhats+tshe da sogs ma gtogs gong bzhin no// ༈ (41) /bung ba myos pa dang 'jig rten gsum lhag par dbang du byed pa dang 'jam dbyangs zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gsum la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du muḥgur gum gyi mdog can las 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nu sku mdog dmar ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal gur gum gyi mdog can/ g.yas zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na ral gri dang*/ mda' dang*/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon gsum na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti dang*/ ut+pal dang*/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ me tog sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/

gzhon nu sgeg pa dang bcas pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rdor sems/ sngags oṃ muḥ mtshan sngags oṃ mañju shrī/ bstod pa gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs so// ༈ (42) /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal shes rab 'phel ba'i cho ga dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs gsum ni/ stong pa'i zhes pa nas dhīḥyig dkar po las 'od zer zhes pa nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na sku mdog kun+da ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri g.yon pusti 'dzin pa zhes pa nas/ bzhugs pa'i bar gong gi a ra pa tsa na lha lnga dang 'dra/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ dhīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ bid+yā dhā ra bi ṭa ka ya saṃ k+ṣip+ta mañju shrī/ bstod pa ri bong 'dzin pa sogs so// ༈ (43) /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i man ngag shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du am̐ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ rang nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mi shes pa gcod pa'i ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti thugs kar 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba'i sku can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas spras pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i lte bar zla ba dang pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar dhīḥlas rang 'dra'i rje btsun a ra pa tsa na/ rtsibs drug la oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa muḥ phyi skor la ṛ l̥ bzhi spangs pa'i dbyangs bcu gnyis/ mu khyud la nga nya na ma bzhi spangs pa'i gsal byed/ rigs bdag spyi 'gre/ sngags auṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa muḥ rdo rje rnon po/

mtshan sngags oṃ pradz+nyā tsakra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (44) /chos kyi dung gi ting nge 'dzin gyi 'jam dpal dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ gzhan rnams gong gi 'jam dpal chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang 'dra ba las/ sa bon mam̐ khyad par ro// ༈ (45) /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkhar hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur/ rdo rje de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i nang du hrīḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dang a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du muṃ yig dkar dmar las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas rje btsun 'jam dpa'i dbyangs zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa/ sku dang rtsa zhal dkar la dmar pa'i mdangs can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dang pusti/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud ces sogs nas bzhugs pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ sarba chos thams cad ngo bo med pa/ dharmāḥbhā wa swa bhā wa rang bzhin rnam par dag pa/ bi shud+dhaḥbadz+ra tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu zhes brgya dpe thams cad na med pa mthun/ a āḥ oṃ āḥpra kṛ ti rang bzhin yongs su dag pa/ pa ri shad+dhāḥsarba dhārmāḥ chos thams cad rnams/ ya du ta 'di lta ste / sarba thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes/ ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya/ mañju 'jam dpal yongs su dag pa/ shrī pa ri shud+dhi tā mu nye bar sbyin pa zhes so/ pā dā ye ti/ a āḥsarba thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po/ ta thā ga tā hri da ya dha ra dha ra/

'dzin gnyis/ oṃ hūm̐ hriḥbha bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi sku/ ga wān dz+nyā na murti/ gsung gi dbang phyug chen po/ wā gī shwa ra mahā pa tsa/ gsung thams cad chos/ sarba dharmā ga nam mkha' 'dri ma med pa/ ga nā ma la su pa ri shud+dhaḥ shin tu dag pa/ dharmāḥdhā tu dz+nya chos dbyings ye shes snying po/ na gar+bha aḥ mtshan sogs oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī/ bstod pa gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs so// ༈ (46) /'jam dpal rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa yi ge gcig pa'i sbyor ba dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mam̐ gur gum gyi mdog lta bu de las 'od zer zhes pa nas rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog lta bu zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal gur gum gyi mdog lta bu/ g.yas zhal in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyi ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis gzhu dang ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can/ rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang*/ 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phro ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ āḥmam̐ hūm̐/ mtshan sngags oṃ madz+nyu shrī badz+ra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// de ltar sgrub thabs sum cu rtsa dgu dang*/ shes rab 'phel ba'i dang*/ yi ge gcig pa'i man ngag ste zhe gcig dang*/ rjes gnang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am rtsa lnga bya'o// nyi shu rtsa bzhi byed par spro na/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs bzhi la rjes gnang gcig byed do// ༈ (47) /mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs bzhi la ni/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi bdud bzhi'i bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba sku mdog zar ma'i me tog ltar sngo zhing grim pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri sngo sangs nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i zhags pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa snying gar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon pa'i pus mo'i mthil dang*/ g.yas pa'i rting pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du btsugs shing bzhengs ma stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gnyis dang ldan pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ dbu skra nag po'i thor tshugs can/ sbrul dkar po'i mchod phyir thogs dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar gyi na bza' dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sku las 'od zer dmar po'i phreng ba 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya a tsa la/ bstod pa/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang*/ sogs so// ༈ (48) /rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i skor la/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso 'khor gsum ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig ljang gu las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi 'jigs pa chen po brgyad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog mar gad ltar ljang ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pal thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyis mdzes par spras pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa'i skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su 'od zer can ma dmar ser/

g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga g.yon du ral gcig ma nag mo g.yon thod pa/ gnyis ka'ang g.yas rnga yab 'dzin cing rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ rigs bdag don yod grub pa/ sngags oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ār+ya tā re/ bstod pa/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (49) /sgrol ma chen mo dang sgrol ma ljang gu'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i zhes pa nas rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma chen mo sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon sdong bu dang bcas pa'i ut+pal bsnams pa/ ral pa'i cod pan dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams snga ma dang 'dra'o// ༈ (50) /mchog sbyin sgrol ma gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs ni/ pam̐ las sna tshogs chu skyes kyi steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas bzhugs pa'i bar seng ldeng nags sgrol ltar bskyed/ de'i g.yas su zla ba la mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can ser mo rin po che sna tshogs pa'i cod pan can/ g.yas ba ku li dang*/ g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ g.yon du zla ba la rma bya chen mo ljang ser g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon rma bya'i mjug sgro 'dzin pa/ g.yon du ral gcig ma nag mo khro mo'i cha lugs can/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' can/ spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra khams pa gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon du 'phags ma dug sel ma ljang gu g.yas rnga yab dang*/ g.yon sbrul nag po 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

rigs bdag 'dra/ 'khor rnams la gtso mo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags/ bstod pa rnams 'dra'o// 'dir dbang du byed pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs la lung rkyang mdzad/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa na rjes gnang yod do// ༈ (51) /gur nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje sgrol ma lha bcu gcig gi sgrub thabs bzhi la ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dkar po'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rnams brtsegs pa'i nang du rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i thar pa chen po'i grong khyer rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ pha gu/ drwa ba/ drwa phyed/ mda' yab pu shu la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang*/ 'dab ma rnams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ sgo bzhir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du dbus su tām̐ yig ser po las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje sgrol ma sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal nag po/ g.yon zhal dmar mo/ rgyab zhal dkar mo/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ gzhon nu ma lang tsho gsar pa rgyas shing chags pa'i nyams can/ phyag g.yas bzhi na rdo rje dang*/ mda' dang*/ dung dang*/ mchog sbyin rnams mdzad pa/

g.yon bzhi na ut+pal dang*/ gzhu dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ sku las 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ shar du oṃ las me tog sgrol ma dkar mo me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lhor tā las bdug spos sgrol ma nag mo g.yas spos snod/ nub tu re las mar me sgrol ma ser mo g.yas mar me'i snod/ byang du tu las dri'i sgrol ma dmar mo g.yas dri'i sgrol ma g.yas dri'i dung chos/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la shar lhor 'khor lo/ lho nub tu rin po che/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du ral gri/ shar sgor tā las lcags kyu ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu/ lho sgor re las zhags pa ma nag mo g.yas zhags pa/ nub sgor tu las lcags sgrog ma ser mo g.yas lcags sgrog byang sgor re las dril bu ma dmar mo g.yas dril bu/ steng du swā las gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma ser mo g.yas 'khor lo/ 'og tu hā las gnod mdzes sgrol ma nag mo g.yas sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang phyag g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad mche ba gtsigs pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ 'gying bag dang bcas pas rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang*/ shar phyogs pa rnams la rnam snang*/ lho phyogs pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub phyogs pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ byang phyogs pa rnams la don yon grub pa/ steng phyogs la rnam snang*/ 'og phyogs la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/

phyag 'tshal lo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la/ na mo ār+ya ā wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ byang chub sems dpa'/ bo dhi satwā ya/ sems dpa' chen po/ ma hā satwā ya/ snying rje chen po can/ 'di lta ste/ sgrol ma/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ngan 'gro las myur du sgrol ma/ tā re tut+tā re thams cad rab tu gdug pa/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃm ma kri te dza m+bha rmugs pa/ ya/ rengs pa/ stam+bha ya mo hā ya/ rmongs pa/ ban+dha ya/ chings/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ thams cad/ stam+bha ni rengs pa tā rā ye swā hā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra tā re sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (52) /rdo rje sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ yig dkar po las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid rdo rje sgrol ma sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal dkar po bsnams pa/ lha rdzas kyi dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ zla ba la rgyab brten pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku'i ba spu'i khung nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'phro ba/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa'/ sngags oṃ tā sgrol ma sdug bsngal las sgrol ma/ re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa snga ma dang 'dra'o// ༈ (53) /sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las zhes pa nas/ bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar seng ldeng nags sgrol ltar las/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du oṃ oṃ swā hā/ lhor oṃ tā swā hā/

nub tu oṃ re swāhā*/ byang du oṃ tu swā hā/ mer oṃ t+tā swā hā/ bden bral du oṃ re swā hā/ rlung du oṃ tu swā hā/ dbang ldan du oṃ re swā hā/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las sa gsum gyi 'jigs pa las skyob par byed pa'i rje btsun sgrol ma brgyad po thams cad kyang sku mdog margad ltar ljang ba sogs gtso mo ltar bskyed/ rigs bdag gtso 'khor thams cad la don yod grub pa/ sngags 'dra/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya āṣ+ṭa ma hā bhā ya tā re/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (54) /rgya nag rim pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs gong 'og ni/ stong pa'i ngang las a dmar po las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dkar zhing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum mnga' ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ sku lus thung zhing lto ba 'phyang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pal 'dzin pa/ ral pa kham pa'i thor tshugs can/ mgo bo'i phreng ba dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ klu chen po brgyad dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi bzad pa'i gad rgyangs sgrogs pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rol pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ma hā tsī na kra ma ār+ya tā ra/ bstod pa gang gi rang bzhin sogs so// ༈ (55) /'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs gsum pa/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khyor steng du tām̐ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsi bsdus/

yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mtheb srin gyis ut+pa la'i rtsa ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od can zla ba la rgyab brten pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes shing gzhon nu lang tsho la babs pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ thugs kar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tāṃ/ de'i mthar oṃ hā'i bar du chud pa'i rang ming gi yi ge/ rtsibs brgyad la yi ge brgyad dang bcas pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ sgrol ma sdug bsngal las sgrol mas bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod/ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma mā yuḥpuṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya tā re/ bstod pa/ 'khor pa las sgrol tā re ma// tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res nad rnams kun las sgrol// sgrol ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so/ ༈ (56) /sgrol ma yid bzhin rgyal mo gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sum̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ri rab kyi steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid rje btsan ma sgrol ma yid bzhin gyi rgyal mo sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i phyag rgya thugs kar mdzad pa/ g.yas 'og mas nor bu dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos dang rgyan gyis lhab lhub tu spras pa/ de'i g.yas su zla ba la 'od zer can ma ser mo g.yas rnga yab dkar po dang*/ g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ sha 'gag dmar po dang*/ sham thabs sngon po gsol ba/ g.yon du zla ba la rma bya chen mo ljang ser g.yas rnga yab dang*/

g.yon rma bya'i mjug sgro 'dzin pa/ na bza' sna tshogs gsol ba/ gnyis ka'ang mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs nas bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ na maḥtā re ma no ha re hūm̐ ha ra swā hā/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa snga ma dang 'dra'o// ༈ (57) /sgrol dkar zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal dkar mo/ g.yas zhal ser mo/ g.yon zhal sngon mo/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ gsum pas mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos ut+pal/ gnyis pas pad+ma/ gsum pas gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu la thod pa rnam pa lnga dang zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lo brgyad gnyis lon pa lta bu/ dur khrod kyi dbus na zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don yod grub pa/ sngags oṃ a tsa le a ni mit+ta wa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (58) /sgrol ma nor sbyin ma gtso 'khor gzungs dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig nag po las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

rdo rje'i rwa ba/ rdo rje'i gur/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las chu skyes dmar po'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bh+rūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo dkar po bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhas yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa'i dbus su snying po'i dkyil 'khor la/ chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ sgo bzhir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du tām̐ yig las 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma nor sbyin ma sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ ut+pal gyi 'dab ma lta bu'i spyan gnyis dang ldan pa/ g.yas gnyis na bgrang phreng dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis na ut+pal dang pusti bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas brgyan pa/ zhi ba'i 'od dang ldan zhing sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma rnams la shar du rdo rje sgrol ma nag mo g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor rin chen sgrol ma ser mo g.yas rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma'i sgrol ma dmar mo g.yas chu skyes/ byang du sangs rgyas sgrol ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo/ mer me tog sgrol ma dkar mo g.yas me tog gi phreng ba/ bden bral du bdug spos sgrol ma nag mo g.yas spos snod/ rlung du mar me sgrol ma ser mo g.yas mar me'i sdong bu/ dbang ldan du dri'i sgrol ma dmar mo g.yas dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyi ut+pal bsnams pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zla ba'i 'od dang sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma nag mo g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa/

nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrog byang sgor dril bu ma dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis ut+pal bsnams pa/ nyi ma'i 'od dang ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ zhal 'jigs pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don yod grub pa/ 'khor rnams la gtso mo/ sngags oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re dha na na me da da swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ār+ya dha na dā na tā ra/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (59) /ngan song las sgrol ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ngan song las sgrol ba'i sgrol ma sku mdog margad ltar ljang ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang pos lcags kyu 'dzin zhing dbugs 'byin pa/ 'og mas mchog sbyin/ g.yon gyi dang pos zhags pa/ 'og mas ut+pal 'dzin pa/ mdzes pa'i phreng ba dang*/ na bza' dkar po mnabs pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag spyi/ sngags na maḥ.ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te ār+ya tā re/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re bī re durga ti ut+tā ra ya hrīṃ hrī hrīṃḥ sarba duḥkhā ta mo tsa ni/ bha ga wa ti durgā tā ra ṇaṃ ma hā yo gash+tsa ri hrīṃḥn mo tu re swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ār+ya tā re/ bstod pa lha dang lha min sogs so// ༈ (60) /sna tshogs yum dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las kā li las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ ā li las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du paṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo sna tshogs yum sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon chu skyes dkar po bsnams pa/ zhal shin tu 'dzum pa rin po che'i rgyan dkar po dang dar dkar po'i na bza' gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag spyi/ sngags oṃ pra bi sna tshogs yum/ shā mā ta/ badz+ra rdo rje tsher ma rnams kaṇ+ḍa ka ṇa nā nyams par mdzod/ sha ya nā sha nyams par mdzod/ ya ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru bdag la zhi bar mdzod/ ku ru swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ bi shwa mā ta/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (61) /don thams cad grub pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dbang po dang drag po dang tshangs pa dang 'khor lo can rnams kyi steng du tām̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma chen mo sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug ma/ rtsa zhal ser po rnam par gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dang po nag po/ gnyis pa ljang gu/ gsum pa sngon po/ g.yon zhal dang po kun+da lta bu/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa nam mkha' lta bu/ steng zhal du ba'i mdog can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas brgyad na ral gri/ ut+pal/ mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ gri gug mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ g.yon brgyad na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ thod pa/ gzhu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rdo rje dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ rin po che/ bum pa rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu skra khams pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'gro ba rnams skyob pa'i stobs chen mo bzhad cing lang tsho gzhon nu dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis rnam par mdzes pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas dbang po dang*/ g.yas brkyangs pas tshangs pa dang*/ bar du drag po dang 'khor lo can mnan nas bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag don yod grub pa/ sngags oṃ pra san+na tā rai a mṛ te a mṛ ta mu khi a mṛ ta lo tsa ne sarba ar+tha sā dha ni sarba satwā wa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya spra san+na tā ra/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i cho ga la rjes gnang mi dgos so// ༈ (62) /'phags ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs gzungs dang bcas pa ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzaṃ ser po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi bi ṣa'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags ma dug sel ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gsum ma/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar/ rtsa zhal ser po/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan zhing spyan gsum gsum mnga'/ khro zhing dgod pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ ral gri/ gar gyi tshul gyis mda' bzung ba/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ dug gi me tog sngon po/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ me tog dang rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bzas brgyan zhing mdzes par byas pa/ ral pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ na maḥsha ra ba ra ku mā rī tsu tsa ri/ tsa li tsa la ya/ tsu tsa la ya/ saṃ gha ṭa ni/ ma hā ma taṅgi/ a ta bi dhe/ a dhe/ oṃ dzaṃ swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya dzaṃ gu lī/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (63) /dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs ni gzhan rnams 'dra/ sngags oṃ dzi gu lī sarba bi ṣa pra sha ma ni phuḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa snga ma ltar ro// dug sel ma'i rig sngags chen mo la ni rjes gnang mi dgos so// ༈ (64) /dug sel ma ljang gu phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer zhes pa nas 'phags ma dug sel ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/

g.yas gnyis na rtse gsum dang rma bya'i mjug sgro/ g.yon gnyis na sbrul dang mi 'jigs pa rab tu brkyangs pa/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang sbrul gyi gdu bu ska rags do shal rna rgyan sogs byas pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag spyi/ sngags oṃ a saṃ dzī hwe badz+ra kā ye gra sa gra sa dz+wa la dz+wa la ma hā yo gi shwa rī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (65) /dug sel ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs gnyis ni/ pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer zhes pa nas lha mo dug sel ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis pi wang sbreng ba/ g.yas 'og mas mi 'jigs pa rab tu sbyin pa/ g.yon 'og mas sbrul dkar po 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan dkar po/ stod g.yogs dkar pos mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dkar po dang*/ sbrul dkar pos brgyan pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi phreng ba 'phro ba/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag spyi/ sngags oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa gong dang 'dra'o// ༈ (66) /lha mo ral gcig ma phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig nag po las byung ba'i 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang bla bre/ steng rdo rje'i gur ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zur gsum pa'i nang du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can nag po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum dmar po ram̐ yig gis= de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pas= de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje=

de'i steng du sum̐ las rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi ri rab lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs sogs kyis brgyan pa/ ka ba brgyad kyi nye bar mdzes par byas pa'i dbus su nyi ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i chos 'byung gi nang du bdud bzhi dang thod pa dkar po'i steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid lha mo ral gcig ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal bcu gnyis kyi rtsa zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal lnga ni dang po dkar po/ gnyis pa ser po/ gsum pa ljang gu/ bzhi pa dmar po/ lnga pa dud ka g.yon zhal lnga ni dang po dmar po/ gnyis pa dkar po/ gsum pa ser po/ bzhi pa ljang gu/ lnga pa dkar dmar/ steng zhal dud ka'i mdog can/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i g.yas pa rnams na ral gri/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin po che'i 'khri shing*/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ mdung*/ tho ba/ gtun shing*/ gri gug ḍa ma ru/ bgrang phreng rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams na gzhu/ zhags pa/ sdigs mdzub/ ba dan/ dbyug pa/ rtse gsum/ chab snod/ ut+pal/ dril bu/ s+t+wa re/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ thod pa rnams 'dzin pa/ ral pa gcig pa'i skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ 'jigs su rung zhing zhal gdangs shing ljags bskyod pa/ khro zhing mi sdug pa/ thung la lto ba 'phyang ba/ nu ma rgyas shing steng du mtho ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lang tsho gzhon zhing phun sum tshogs pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags hrīḥtrīṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags oṃ e ka dza ṭī/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (67) /ral gcig ma phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs gsum la ni/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ṭaṃ las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po'i steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo ral gcig ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dkar zhing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra khams pa gyen du 'god pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu bsnams pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pal 'dzin pa brgyad gnyis lon pa'i gzugs can/ 'o 'dzin rab tu rgyas shing mtho bar langs pa/ do shal dpung rgyan g.yer kha la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ me tog gi phreng bas mdzes shing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan cing*/ sbrul gyis sku la brgyan pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ g.yon cung zad brkyangs pas bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams 'dra'o// ༈ (68) /ral gcig ma nag mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ ṭaṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid ral gcig ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa sogs snga ma dang 'dra'o// yang phyag brgyad ma byed na gdan dang sa bon 'dra ba las phyag g.yas rus phreng*/ ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje gri gug g.yon ut+pal/ gzhu/ s+t+wa gri/ thod pa bsnams pa/ gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra'o// de ltar sgrub thabs sum cu rtsa gsum dang rjes gnang mi dgos pa'i gzungs gsum dang bcas pa kun dril bas sgrub thabs sum cu rtsa drug las rigs mthun rnams phyogs gcig tu byas pa'i rjes gnang nyi shu rtsa gcig yod do//

༈ (69) /rdo rje gur nas bshad pa'i lha mo tsun+de'i sgrub thabs gsum la ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tsuṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo tsun+da sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dkar zhing 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang pos mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos pad+ma dkar po'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kas mnyam gzhag mdzad pa'i steng na lhung bzed bsnams pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos dang rgyan lhab lhub kyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags/ oṃ tsa le tsu le tsun+de swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya tsun+de/ bstod pa spyi'o// ༈ (70) /rtog pa las gsungs pa'i lha mo 'od zer can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin gyi mchod rten gyi bum pa gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i nang du phag bdun gyi drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng na khyab 'jug dbang po bde byed tshangs pa ste bdud bzhi dang*/ shing rta'i 'og na gza' brgyad dang*/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi mi'i gzugs su yod pa ste de rnams kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mam̐ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi chom rkun gyi nyer 'tshe zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par byas te/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid lha mo 'od zer can kun+da'i mdog can zhal lnga phyag bcu ma/ zhabs bzhi ma/ rtsa zhal dkar mo/ g.yas zhal nag mo/ g.yon zhal phag gdong dmar mo/ rgyab zhal ljang gu/

steng zhal ser mo rin po ches spras pa'i ral pa'i cod pan rtse gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pa lnga na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ rdo rje sngon po/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ khab rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa lnga na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gzhu/ mya ngan med pa'i yal ga zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ skud pa rnams 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ sha 'gag dkar po/ zhabs bzhis bdud bzhi brdzis pa/ de'i mdun du chu srin mnan pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma nag mo phag gdong can/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ g.yas su lha mo phag zhal can dmar mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na lcags kyu dang khab/ g.yon gnyis na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ skud pa/ g.yon du lha mo phag zhal can dmar mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na mda' dang rdo rje/ g.yon pa gnyis na gzhu dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ dang pos mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du bkang ba/ sna tshogs pa'i na bzas brgyan zhing bzhengs stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ mā rī ts+yai maṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ma rī ts+yai/ bstod pa/ gang gis mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// bar du gcod pa kun las sgrol mdzad cing*// dri med bde ba chen po stsol mdzad ma// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (71) /mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can ser mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs gong 'og ni/ stong pa'i ngang las phag gi rgyab tu pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mam̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas mya ngan med pa'i lha mo 'od zer can sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa/ lang tsho la babs pa'i mdzes ma 'gying bag dang bcas pa/ dar dkar po'i na bzas spras pa/ zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ mā rī ts+yai maṃ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (72) /rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can ser mo phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs bzhi la ni/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gza' rā hu la stod khog las me dang nyi ma dang zla ba/ bdud/ gdon pa/ sa bon/ bzung ba/ de'i steng na phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa'i rnam par snang mdzad yongs su gyur pa'i mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng du maṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas lha mo 'od zer can sku mdog ser mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal gser btso ma'i mdog can/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing zlum pa/ g.yon zhal phag gi gdong pa can nag mo/ ljags bskyod cing khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na lcags kyu/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na khab/ g.yon gyi dang po na mya ngan med pa'i yal ga gnyis pa na gzhu/ gsum pa na skud pa/ bzhi pa na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ dar dmar po'i sha 'gag dang stod g.yogs mnabs pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ de'i shar du bat+tā li dmar mo phag gi gdong pa can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na khab dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa/ lhor pa dā li ser mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang khab/ g.yon gnyis na rdo rje dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu ba rā li dkar mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang khab/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa/ byang du ba rā ha mu khi dmar mo spyan gsum ma/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa/

thams cad kyang lang tsho la babs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gis stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams 'od zer can dkar mo dang 'dra'o// ༈ (73) /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma 'od zer can phyag bcu gnyis ma gtso 'khor gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs lnga la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus su o ḍi ya na'i gnas kyi ngo bo chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dkar la dmar ba'i nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas lha mo 'od zer can sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma/ rtsa zhal dmar mo/ g.yas su ser mo dang nag mo'i zhal gnyis/ g.yon du dkar mo dang nag mo'i zhal gnyis/ steng zhal phag pa'i zhal nag po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ dgra s+t+wa/ mda'/ gtun shing rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa drug na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i khab/ rtse gsum/ mya ngan med pa'i yal ga gzhu/ zhags pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing ljags 'dril ba/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ ha ha zhes drag tu dgod cing bdud bzhi mnan pa'i zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ shing rta'i nang gi dbus su lha mo phyag gnyis ma sdigs mdzub dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bgegs mnan pa/ dbu skra khams pa gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba can/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/

rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa rī sarba duṣ+ṭan ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa oṃ mā rī ts+yai maṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri mā rī ts+yai/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (74) /'od zer can pi tsu ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las don dam chos sku'i ngo bo rnam par thar pa sgo gsum gyi sku gdung gi mchod rten chos kyi dbyings nang gru bzhi pa'i dbus su gdug pa can mnan pa'i brag ri dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas lha mo 'od zer can pi tsu ma sku mdog dzam bu na dā'i mdog can zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal ser ba/ g.yas zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dkar ba/ g.yas bzhi na rdo rje/ khab/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na zhags pa/ skud pa/ mya ngan med pa'i shing*/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs skyil krung dag gis dbang phyug dang gau rī thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin gyis mnan nas bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rin chen 'byung ldan/ sngags oṃ mā rī ts+yai maṃ sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags oṃ mā rī ts+yai pi tsu ba/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (75) /'od zer can ma dmar mo phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du oṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas lha mo 'od zer can sku mdog dmar mo zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ rtsa zhal dmar zhing zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal ni phag dmar po dang dmar skya/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas pa drug na khab/ lcags kyu/ bhiṇ+ḍi ba la/ ral gri/ rdo rje dbyug pa/ rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yon pa drug na mya ngan med pa'i me tog sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ thod pa/ skud pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ bum pa bzang po rnams bsnams pa/

dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ stod g.yogs dmar po dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas tshangs pa la sogs pas phyag byed cing*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad 'jigs pas 'dud pa/ phyag 'tshal zhing bka' bsgrub par mdzad pa'i sku can du gyur pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang*/ sngags oṃ mā rī ts+yai sarba duṣ+ṭan mā ra ya hūm̐/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// de ltar sgrub thabs bco lnga gzungs bklag thabs dang bcu drug la rigs mthun phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pas rjes gnang drug yod do// ༈ (76) /ri khrod lo ma gyon ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du paṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi rims nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo ri khrod ma sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal ser mo 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing zhi ba'i nyams can/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos thugs kar rdo rje/ gnyis pas dgra s+t+wa 'debs pa'i tshul byed pa/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gnyis pas 'bras bu dang me tog gis spud pa'i shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang yab/ gsum pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ me tog sna tshogs pas bcings pa'i ral pa'i cod pan can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing shing lo gsar pa'i sham thabs dang*/ dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs can/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pas 'og sgo bkag cing pus mo gdan la btsugs pa/ g.yon pa'i zhabs mthil gdan la btsugs te bzhengs ma stabs su mdzad de bgegs kyi steng na bzhugs pa/ sku las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i 'od zer 'phro ba/
rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ

sha ma ri khrod lo ma can rims nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i ched du gzhi tshugs/ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma na swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya par+ṇa sha wa rī/ bstod pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i// lha mo gang gis sgrub po'i nad gdon bgegs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (77) /ri khrod lo ma can ljang gu'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du paṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas lha mo ri khrod ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal margad ltar ljang ba/ g.yas zhal mthing nag g.yon zhal dkar ba/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa khro zhing bzhad pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na dgra s+t+wa/ gsum pa na mda'/ g.yon gyi dang po na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gnyis pa na shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang yab/ gsum pa na gzhu 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ me tog sna tshogs kyi phreng ba bcings shing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ lang tsho gzhon zhing lto ba cung zad 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis nad dang bdud ma lus pa mnan nas bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don yod grub pa/ sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams 'dra'o// ri khrod ma'i gzungs la lung gis chog go/ ༈ (78) /sher phyin dkar mo gur nas gsungs pa'i sgrub thabs gsum la ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dkar mo 'dab ma brgyad pa sdong bu dang bcas pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ yig dkar po las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i ma rig pa bsal/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse spobs pa gzungs la sogs pa rnams spyan drangs te/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

phyag gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mthil nas gyes pa'i g.yas ngos su pad+ma dkar po dang*/ g.yon ngos su pad+ma dmar po'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti re re 'dzin pa/ dbu skra phyed du li ba rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas spras pa/ zhal mchu dang phyag dang zhabs mthil rnams dmar ba/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu ras bal gyi 'dab ma lta bur phra mor 'bigs pa'i shes rab bskyed/ 'od gsal ba 'bar bar byed/ pradz+nyā war+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha 'dzin blo bskyed/ war+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri dkyil nas sangs rgyas bskyed/ bud+dhi war+dha ni swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ār+ya pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā/ bstod pa ni/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yul la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (79) /sher phyin ser mo'i sgrub thabs bzhi la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi pram̐ ser po las zhes pa nas rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mthil nas gyes pa'i ut+pa la sngon po gnyis snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes shing rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ pradz+nye ma hā pradz+nye shru ti smṛ ti bi dza ya dhīḥswā hā/ yang sngags gcig la oṃ dhīḥ(80)shrum̐ ti smṛ ti bi dzā ya swā hā/ zhes dang*/ sngags (81)oṃ āḥdhī swā hā/

mtshan sngags/ bstod pa'i bar 'dra ste/ de dag la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad snang bas re re byung na legs pa 'dra zhing phyag len la ni gcig tu mdzad cing de ltar bya'o// yang so sor byed na gdan sa bon rigs bdag sogs sngar dang 'dra bar byas nas/ sngags ring thung so sor phral nas rjes gnang lnga byed pa ni gong gi spyi bshad dang mthun no// ༈ (82) /gser mdog can gyi sher phyin phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs gong 'og ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥser po las 'od zer zhes pa nas bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog gser mdog can zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas 'og mas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pal sngon po'i steng du sher phyin gyi pusti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang*/ dar gyi na bza' sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag spyi/ sngags/ na mo bha ga wa t+yai pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā ya/ a mi ta gu ṇa ye/ bhak+ṣi bad tsha lā ye/ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na pa ri pū ri tā ye/ sa hā bad cha lā ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃdhiḥkar+ṇa kā yaṃ/ shru ti smṛ ti bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes pa 'di rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi phyag bris las bshus so// zhes bdag gi bla ma'i phyag dpe la mchan mdzad 'dug pa ltar bris pa yin no// mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// de ltar sgrub thabs dgu la rigs mthun phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pas rjes gnang lnga yod do// ༈ (83) /gshin rje dgra nag nas bshad pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs gsum ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du doḥyig dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyangs can ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na pad+ma/ ral gri/ gri gug g.yon pa gsum na 'khor lo/ rin po che/ thod pa 'dzin pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ 'jam po 'jam po shes rab 'phel zhing*/ pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā war+dha ni/ 'bar ba 'bar ba yid gzhung 'phel dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dha ni/ ba blo 'phel/ dhi ri dhi ri bud+dhi war+dha ni swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra swa ra swa sti/ bstod pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs 'ongs shing*// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog ster ba// lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (84) /dbyangs can ma dkar mo lha lnga'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse gzungs spobs pa la sogs pa 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon sdong bu dang bcas pa'i chu skyes dkar po 'dzin pa/ mdun du shes rab ma/ g.yas su blo can ma/ rgyab tu blo gros ma/ g.yon du dran pa ma ste de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pas pad dkar 'dzin pa ste/ de thams cad kyang zhal 'dzum zhing shin tu brtse ba'i bdag nyid can/

tsan+dan dkar po dang me tog gi na bza' mnabs pa/ mu tig gi do shal gyis thugs kar nye bar mdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can/ nu ma 'bur zhing nang rgyas pa/ rked pa byin gyis phra ba/ nang nas 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas 'jig rten gsum po snang bar byed pa'i sku can/ spyi'i rigs bdag go /sngags oṃ hrīḥm hā ma yāṃ ge ma hā swa ri swa t+yai na maḥ mtshan sngags oṃ swa ra swa sti/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (85) /rdo rje dbyangs can ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du am̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid rdo rje dbyangs can ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas chu skyes dmar po dang*/ g.yon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ pi tsu pi tsu sogs dang*/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams 'dra'o// ༈ (86) /pi wang dbyangs can ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer zhes pa nas bcom ldan 'das ma pi wang dbyangs can ma zhal gcig ma/ phyag gnyis kyis pi wang sgrogs pa'i tshul mdzad pa/ dbu skra phyed li ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ de'i thugs kar a las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i dbus su zla ba la hrīḥ rigs bdag spyi 'gro/ sngags hrīḥ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra bī nā swa ra swa sti/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (87) /rdo rje dbyangs can ma phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dkar po'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer zhes pa nas pusti 'dzin pa'i bar gong ltar bskyed/

dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag spyi/ sngags thiṃlha/ mtshan sngags bstod pa gong gi rdo rje dbyangs can ma dang 'dra'o// de ltar sgrub thabs brgyad la rigs mthun phyogs gcig tu byas pas rjes gnang lnga yod do// ༈ (88) /khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+ṝ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags ma khro gnyer can sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis rin po che'i dbyug pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos dang rgyan lhab lhub kyis mdzes par byas pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ bh+rī swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya bh+rī ku ṭi/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (89) /ku ru kul+le'i skor la/ dang po rtog pa nas gsungs pa'i ku ru kul+le phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs drug la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo rig byed ma sku mdog bye ru'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba lta bu dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs pa/ g.yas 'og mas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/

g.yon 'og mas ut+pal dmar po 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar dmar po'i na bza' can/ 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ rig byed kyi phug na sgra gcan gyi mgo bo la gnas pa'i 'dod lha chung ma dang bcas pa'i steng na g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya ku ru kul+le/ bstod pa/ brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku// mda' gzhu ut+pal mi 'jigs phyag rgya can// bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (90) /gnyis pa kye rdo rje'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i rig byed ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs bzhi la ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur/ me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su e'i rnam pa'i chos 'byung dkar dmar gyi nang du hrīḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ro'i gdan gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer zhes pa nas/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ut+pal dmar po'i mde'u can gyi mda' dang*/ me tog dmar po'i gzhu rna ba'i drung du bkang ste 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ut+pal dmar po las byas pa'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pal dmar po'i steng na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ cung zad mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ dges shing rngams la 'gying ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/

rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan zhing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ ku ru kul+li hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa'i tshig rkang gsum 'dra/ mda' gzhu ut+pal phyag gis lcags kyu bsnams// zhes brjod/ gzhan 'dra'o// ༈ (91) /gsum pa rig byed ma phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du a las zla ba dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo rig byed ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig ma/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang ut+pal bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu rna ba'i bar 'gengs pa/ lang tsho gzhon zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ gser la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stod g.yogs na bza' dmar po dang sha 'gag dmar po mnabs shing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag lnga/ sngags oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥ

rig byed kyi phug na gnas pa'i sgrol ma zer/ hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa spyi'o// ༈ (92) /bzhi pa rig byed ma dmar mo phyag brgyad ma gtso 'khor rnams kyi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ gsum pa gnyis kyis mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang ut+pal bsnams pa/ dar dmar po'i na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du rab tu dwangs pa'i sgrol ma/ lhor rdzogs pa'i sgrol ma/ nub tu rgyal ba'i sgrol ma/ byang du snang ba'i sgrol ma/ dbang ldan du tsun+da/ mer mi thub ma/ bden bral du mar me'i sgrol ma/ rlung du gau ri'i sgrol ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang ut+pal bsnams pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar sgor ro langs ma dmar mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na sdigs mdzub dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na dril bu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho sgor gzhan gyis mi thub ma ser mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na dril bu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor ral gcig ma nag mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ g.yon 'dra/ byang sgor rdo rje gan+dha ri ser mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang lcags kyu/

g.yon 'dra/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni/ gtso 'khor bcu gsum la rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ ku ru kul+le hūm̐ hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa snga ma ltar ro// ༈ (93) /lnga pa rig byed ma dkar mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer zhes pa nas bcom ldan 'das ma rig byed ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum dang ldan ma/ g.yas pas ut+pa la'i bgrang phreng dang g.yon pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ me tog sna tshogs pas nye bar mdzes pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ ku ru kal+le hrīḥswāhā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (94) /drug pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba stong phrag bcu drug pa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i ku ru kul+le dkar mo phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol tu ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su e las chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa'i nang du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag drug ma/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/

bar pa gnyis kyis mi 'jigs pa dang*/ kun+da dkar po'i dog pa bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs bsnams pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gser la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ na bza' dkar po dang stod g.yogs dkar po can/ lang tsho gzhon zhing rgyas pa/ sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ bya khyung gi steng na rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa/ rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ ma hā rak+ṣaḥku ru kul+le hrīḥn mo bau ṣaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// dbang du byed pa'i man ngag sgrub thabs zhes pa'i man ngag rig byed ma'i man ngag gi rim pa/ las la rab tu sbyor ba dang bzhi bsnan pas bcu dgu/ rigs mthun rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pas rjes gnang drug yod do// ༈ (95) /'og gi gtsug tor rnam pa rgyal ma phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal kun+da ltar dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal kun+da ltar dkar ba/ g.yas zhal gser gyi mdog can/ g.yon zhal in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ cung zad khro ba/ zhal re re la zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na sna tshogs rdo rje/ pad dkar la gnas pa'i 'od dpag med/ mda'/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon bzhi na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gzhu/ mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa rnams 'dzin pa/ lang tsho la babs pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa/
