rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bzas mdzes par byas pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ dpral bar trām̐ ser po/ lte bar hrīḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la oṃ aḥljang gu/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ */mchog gi bdud rtsis gang ba legs par gsungs/ bh+rūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ uṣ+ṭhi ṣ+ṇa bi dza ya/ bstod pa/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ma'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (96) /ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i rtog pa nas gsungs pa'i rnam rgyal lha dgu ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhes sogs nas bum pa rnams 'dzin/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i phreng ba 'phro ba/ de'i g.yas su zla ba la spyan ras gzigs dkar po g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ g.yon du nyi ma la phyag na rdo rje sngon po g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon ut+pal la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang zhi ba'i nyams can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/

nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang du stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ skra gyen du brdzes shing*/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i steng gi phyogs gnyis na gnas gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha'i bu gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas bcom ldan 'das ma la sku khrus gsol ba dang bcas pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po zhes pa gong ltar ro/ rigs bdag ni gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/ phyag na rdo rje dang khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan/ sngags oṃ bh+rūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ gang ba 'chi med/ a mṛ tā tshe sbyin/ yūrda legs par gsungs/ de swāhā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ a mi te/ a mi tod bha we/ a mi ta bi krān+te/ a mi ta gā te/ a mi ta ga mi ni/ a mi ta ā yurda te/ ga ga na kīrti ka re/ sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka rī ye swā hā/ zhes snying po nye snying phreng sngags so/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (97) /'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi gdon thams cad nye bar zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnams tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can sku mdog gangs ri'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dkar zhing zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/

g.yas zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba ste/ zhal re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis na 'khor lo dang rdo rje dkar po/ bar pa gnyis na mda' dang gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes par byas pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ khro mo'i lta stangs dang bcas pas gza' thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i sku can/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ a pa rā dzi tā sarba gra ha a nu trā sa ya trā sa ya/ ha na ha na/ druṃ druṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya si tā ta pa tre/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (98) /rdo rje tsa rtsi kā'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ ro'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lte bar tsaṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rdo rje tsa rtsi kā sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gcig spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum na rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum na thod pa nor bu chu skyes rnams 'dzin pa/ sku lus rid cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi mgo'i phreng bas mgul pa brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing skra grol ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs mnabs pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ badz+ra tsa rtsi ke swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra tsa rtsi ke/ bstod pa spyi'o// ༈ (99) /rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba nas 'byung ba'i srung ba lnga'i gtso rkyang rnams las/ dang po sor 'brang gi sgrub thabs gsum ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du praṃ las 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog ser mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal gser btso ma'i mdog can/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ rgyab zhal sngo ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na rdo rje/ zhags pa/ dgra s+t+wa/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po can 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ rigs bdag spyi/ sngags oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+rī ṇi ma hā pra ti swa re swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ma hā pra ti sā re/ bstod pa spyi'o// ༈ (100) /gnyis pa rma bya chen mo ni/ stong pa'i zhes pa nas maṃ las bcom ldan 'das ma rma bya chen po sku mdog margad ltar ljang ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal ljang gu/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas gsum na rma bya'i mjug sgro/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum na rin po che'i rnga yab/ gzhu/ dku g.yon du bum pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang*/ dar gyi na bza' 'chang ba lang tsho gzhon zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub/ sngags oṃ ma hā mā yu rī bid+ya rā dz+nyī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ mtshan sngags oṃ ma hā mā yu rī bid+yā rā dz+nyī/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (101) /gsum pa stong chen rab 'joms ni/ stong pa'i zhes pa nas bhūm̐ las stong chen rab 'joms sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag drug ma/ g.yas na ral gri/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon na gzhu/ zhags pa/

dgra s+t+wa rnams 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i rgyab rten dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ lang tsho gzhon zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ bh+rūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags ma hā swā ha sra pra marda na/ spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (102) /bzhi pa gsang sngags rjes 'dzin ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis na dgra s+t+wa dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ rin po che'i rgyan sogs dang*/ bzhugs tshul snga ma dang 'dra/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ma hā man+t+ra ma nu sa ni/ spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (103) /lnga pa bsil ba'i tshal ni pad nyi la dz+rīṃ las bcom ldan 'das ma bsil ba'i tshal chen mo sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon lcags kyu dang thugs kar pusti 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol sogs nas bzhugs pa'i bar snga ma dang 'dra'o// rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ma hā shī ta ba ti/ spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (104) /drug pa gzungs grwa lnga nas bshad pa'i srung ba lnga'i sgrub thabs gnyis ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i 'og sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa bas bskor ba/ de'i dbus su sum̐ las ri rab kyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dbus su pram̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog dkar mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/

rtsa zhal ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ g.yas zhal nag po/ g.yon zhal dmar po/ rgyal zhal ser po/ zhal re re la zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na 'khor lo/ gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po na rdo rje zhags pa/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na dgra s+t+wa rnams 'dzin pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can/ spyi bor zla ba la gnas pa'i mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ byang chub kyi shing gis nye bar mdzes shing sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ me tog dang 'bras bu la sogs pas brgyan pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab yol can/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ shar du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma sku mdog nag mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ tsa zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal dkar po/ g.yon zhal ljang gu/ rgyab zhal ser po/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na mchog sbyin dang rdo rje/ gnyis pa na lcags kyu/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gnyis pa na dgra s+t+wa/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na pad+ma'i steng na rin po che cha drug pa rnams 'dzin pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing mi'i thod pas brgyan pa/ rin po che la sogs pa rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ n+ya gro dha'i shing ljon pas nye bar mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// lhor sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maṃ las rma bya chen mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal gser btso ma'i mdog can/ g.yas zhal mthing nag g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa na rin po che'i bum pa/

gsum pa na 'khor lo/ bzhi pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po na lhung bzed kyi steng na dge slong*/ gnyis pa na rma bya'i mdongs/ gsum pa na bum pa'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rje/ bzhi pa na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan rnams 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i cod pan la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mya ngan med pa'i shing ljon pas nye bar mdzes pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// nub tu sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maṃ las gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dkar ba/ zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas zhal nag pa/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ gnyis pa gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na mchog sbyin/ bzhi pa na skyabs sbyin/ lnga pa na rdo rje/ drug pa na mda'/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa/ bzhi pa na gzhu/ lnga pa na rin po che'i dogs/ drug pa na pad+mas mtshan pa'i chu skyes rnams 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ lang tsho gzhon nu dang ldan pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ shi ri sha'i shing ljon pas nye bar mdzes pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// byang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du trām̐ las bsil ba'i tshal chen mo sku mdog ljang gu zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ljang ba/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya/ gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na mda'/ g.yon gyi dang po na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gnyis pa na gzhu/ gsum pa na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ lha'i na bzas mdzes par byas pa/

nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ tsaṃ pa ka'i shing ljon pas nye bar mdzes pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o// rigs bdag ni gtso mo dang gsang sngags rjes 'dzin la mi bskyod pa/ stong chen rab 'joms la rnam snang*/ rma bya chen mo la don yod grub pa/ bsil ba'i tshal la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ

nor bu 'dzin pa rdo rje can so sor 'brang ma chen mo/ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ngan 'gro 'joms pa rnams rdo rjes 'dren pa/ ṇi ma hā sdug bsngal chen por zhugs pa rnams 'joms zhing snang ba med par byed pa/ pra ti sā re 'joms par byed ma gnyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ltung bar byed ma gnyis/ gzhi tshug phaṭa swā hās sor 'brang dang*/ oṃ a bdud rtsi mchog mṛ ta wa mchog re wa ra rab mchog ma/ pa wa re bi rnam dag ma/ shud+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hās stong chen dang*/ oṃ a mṛ bdud rtsi rnam gzigs snying po la/ ta bi lo ki ni gar+bha saṃ rak+ṣa ṇa kun nas srung mdzad 'gugs mdzad ma/ ā kar+ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hās rma bya chen mo dang*/ oṃ dri ma med pa la rnam rgyal ma/ bi ma l+ya bi pu l+ya dza rgyal mchog ma/ ya wā re a mṛ bdud rtsi/ te bi ra dze hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hās gsang sngags rjes 'dzin dang*/ oṃ rgyas pa gnyis/ bha ra bha ra bde ba rgyas pa gnyis/ sam+bha rasam+bha ra in+d+ra dbang po/ ya ba la stobs/ bi rnam par sbyong ma/ shwa dha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hās bsil ba'i tshal chen mo/ mtshan sngags oṃ pañca rak+ṣa de wī sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (105) /yang sor 'brang ser mo zhal gsum phyag bcu ma gtso 'khor lnga pa gcig ste/ de'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥpram̐ maṃ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ dzam̐ hūm̐ zhes pa'o// bdag gi bla mas 'di gnyis la rjes gnang gcig grangs 'dren pa'i tshe so sor bgrang ngo*// ༈ (106) /phyir bzlog ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid phyir bzlog ma chen mo sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag drug ma/

g.yas gsum na ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum na pad+ma dmar po/ rtse gsum/ thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lang tsho gzhon zhing zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ma hā pra t+yaṅgi ka spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (107) /'phags ma rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ni/ stong pa'i zhes pa nas hūm̐ las lha mo rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sku mdog nag mo zhal gsum phyag bzhi ma/ rtsa zhal mthing nag g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal ljang gu/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang zhags pa/ g.yon pa gnyis na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang 'khor lo bsnams pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ na bza' ser po'i sha 'gag can/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ 'od zer dang ldan pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ bha ga wa ti dh+wa dzā gra ke yū rā/ spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (108) /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma dang bcas pa'i steng du dh+waṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma g.yul las sgrol bar byed pa'i lha mo sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma/ rtsa zhal ser po/ g.yas zhal dkar po/ g.yon zhal dmar po/ steng zhal 'jigs shing du ba'i mdog can/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing khro ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang 'khor lo/

g.yon gnyis na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa nag po dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gtun zhing dkar po 'dzin pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbur brgyan pa/ dar sngon po'i na bza' can/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ sngags oṃ bha ga wa tī dh+wa dza gra ke yū re pa ra sain+ya bi dh+waṃ sa na ka ri swa sai n+ya ba ri bā la ni/ u la kā mu khe kha kha khā hi khā hi/ pa ri sain+yaṃ a nan+da mu khe na a nan+ta bhu dze na pra ha ra pra ha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa snga ma dang 'dra'o// ༈ (109) /gzhan gyis mi thub ma ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tshogs bdag glang sna bsgyel ba'i steng du oṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas thal mo brkyangs te 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ tshangs pa la sogs pa lha'i tshogs kyis gdugs bzung nas bskor ba/ rigs bdag rnam snang*/ sngags oṃ ām̐ swā hā zhes pa'am/ yang na gdugs dkar can gyi sngags bzla bar bdag gi bla ma'i phyag dpe dang phyag len la mdzad pas gang rung byas pas chog go /mtshan sngags ār+ya a pa rā dzi ta/ spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (110) /rdo rje gan+dha ri'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs nus mthu rnams tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rdo rje gan+dha ri sku mdog nag mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma/ rtsa zhal nag mo/

g.yas zhal dkar/ g.yon zhal dmar/ rgyab zhal ljang*/ steng zhal ser po dang sngon po brtsegs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas drug na rdo rje dril bu ral gri rtse gsum mda' 'khor lo/ g.yon drug na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lcags kyu gzhu dgra s+t+wa zhags pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā zhes pa'am/ yang na/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ na mo bha ga wa tī/ ma hā badz+ra gan+dha rī/ a ni ka sha ta sa ha sra/ pra dz+wa li te/ dīp+te dza yai/ ugribhī ma bhā yā na kā yai/ yo gi nī yai bhīṣ+mā bha gi nī yai/ dā dwa sha bhu dzā yai/ bi kīr+ṇa kai shī yai/ a ne ka rū pa bi bidha we shadha ri ṇī yai/ e h+ye hi/ bha ga wa tī ma hā badz+ra gān+dha rī/ sid+dha ra/ trā ya nāṃ/ rat+nā nāṃ/ sat+ye na/ ā kadha adha/ ba de bā da ka ye tsā h+ya/ sa ma ye hi tiṣ+ṭha nā ta hi nā pa ta yaṣ+yā mi/ shī gh+ra gṛh+ṇa griṇ+ḍa/ oṃ a la a la hu lu hu lu/ mu lu mu lu/ tsu lu tsu lu/ dhā ma dhā ma/ raṅga raṅga/ raṅgā pa ya raṅgā pa ya/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ a bhi sha a bh-i sha bha ga wa tī/ ma hā badz+ra gan dhā rī/ sid+dha tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇi ra dz+nyā pa ya ti/ hrīḥha aḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ār+ya badz+ra gān dharī/ spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (111) /rdo rje lcags sgrog ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rdo rje lcags sgrog sku mdog ljang gu zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal ljang*/ g.yas zhal dkar/ g.yon zhal dmar/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/

phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ rdo rje lcags sgrog mda'/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan zhing zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag spyi/ sngags oṃ badz+ra shrīṃ kha le hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra shrīṃ kha le/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (112) /rdo rje lcags sgrog ma phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas rdo rje zhes pa nas rdo rje lcags sgrog sku mdog margad ltar ljang ba/ zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal ljang gu cung zad bzhad pa/ g.yas zhal ser skya spyan ser skya dang ldan pa/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing khro gnyer can/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na mi 'jigs pa/ rdo rje/ rdo rje lcags sgrog mda'/ g.yon bzhi na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ser skya gyen du 'khyil ba/ rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan zhing byi la'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs mnabs pa/ zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sprin tshogs 'phro ba/ rigs bdag sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams snga ma dang 'dra'o// ༈ /nor lha'i skor la/ (112)dang po nor rgyun ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid dzam bha lar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo nor rgyun ma/ mdun du dpal gyi nor/ g.yas phyogs su nor brtan ma/ rgyab phyogs su dpal gyi nor zhal ma/ g.yon phyogs su nor bu'i blo gros brtan ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i phreng ba bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' can/ lo brgyad gnyis lon pa lta bu/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag gtso mo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la gtso mo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ ba su dhā ṛ ṇi swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba su swā hā/ oṃ ba su shrī ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba su mu khi swā hā/ oṃ ba su shrī ye swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ de wi ba su dha ra sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa/ sngon gyi sbyin pa'i dpal las legs 'khrungs shing*// mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa// 'gro ba'i dbul phongs ma lus sel mdzad ma// dpal mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (114) /gnyis pa gur nas gsungs pa'i nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du paṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mdza' ba'i skye 'gro rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ shrī ba su ni dha na k+ṣe tra swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ba su dha ri/ bstod pa/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma// dpal dang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma// yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad ma// bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la bstod// ces so// gsum pa nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi man ngag la rjes gnang mi dgos so// ༈ (115) /bzhi pa dzam+bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs zhes pa nas hūm̐ las bdag nyid 'phags pa dzam+bhā la sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

mi'u thung gi gzugs can/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ gcer bu rna ba ma phug pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas na thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang*/ g.yon na rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis nor bdag ser po kha nas rin po che skyug pa mnan pa/ 'od zer gyi tshogs du ma 'phro ba/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ dza rmugs 'dzin chu'i dbang po la gzhi tshugs/ la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la/ bstod pa/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam+bha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (116) /lnga pa gur nas bshad pa'i dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i zhes pa nas dzam̐ las 'phags pa dzam+bha la sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung dang pad+ma'i gter mnan pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i phreng ba dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams snga ma dang 'dra'o// ༈ (117) /drug pa dzam+bha la phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzaṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas rang nyid dzam+bha la sku mdog ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas gsum na mā tu lung ba/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon gsum gyi dang pos g.yon phyogs na gnas pa'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma gnyis na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i ne'u le dang*/ gzhu bkang ba 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing ral pa'i cod pan can/ 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/

rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags mtshan sngags bstod pa rnams 'dra'o// ༈ (118) /bdun pa dzam+bha la ser po lha dgu'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzam̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas rang nyid dzam+bha la sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung dang pad+ma'i gter mnan pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i phreng ba dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du nor bu bzang po/ lhor gang ba bzang po/ nub tu nor sbyin/ byang du rnam thos sras/ mer kī li mi lī/ bden bral du pi tsi kaṇ+ḍa li/ rlung du mu khon+d+ra/ dbang ldan du tsa ren+d+ra ste thams cad kyang zhal gcig ces pa nas brgyan pa/ gtso bo la sogs pa'i dku g.yon du lha mo nor rgyun ma/ chu shel ma/ so ma/ so legs ma/ 'phags ma/ bzang mo/ shin tu bzang mo/ sbas ma/ dbyangs can ma ste thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pas yab rnams la 'khyud pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa/ rigs bdag rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams 'dra'o// ༈ (119) /brgyad pa gang ba bzang po'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i dpal gnod gnas 'khor bcas kyi sgrub thabs gnyis ni/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi ngo bo zla ba dkar dmar yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la baṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas rang nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma/ shar du bzang mo/ lhor rab tu bzang mo/ nub tu sbas ma/ byang du rab tu sbas ma/ shar lhor lha mo/ lho nub tu dbyangs can ma/ nub byang du 'phags ma/ byang shar du zla shel can ma rnams sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/

g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i bha ga'i nang du gzhal yas khang gi dbus su dzaṃ las dpal gnod gnas sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung dang pad+ma'i tshogs mnan zhing rin po che'i char 'bebs pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i phreng ba can/ nor rgyun ma ser mo 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems phyir 'phros pas rin po che'i tshogs nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par gyur te/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las/ gnod sbyin chen po bcu drug tu gyur te/ shar du gang ba bzang po dmar po/ lhor rnam thos sras ser po/ nub tu nor sbyin dmar po/ byang du nor bu bzang po ser po/ shar lhor pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li dmar po/ lho nub tu rol pa'i phreng ba sngon po/ nub byang du spyod pa'i dbang po ser po/ byang shar du sgo'i dbang po ser po ste thams cad kyang bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ ne'u le 'dzin pa/ shar sgor nor sbyin dang nor sbyin chen po/ lho sgor pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po/ nub sgor ki li dang ki li chen po/ byang sgor gang ba dang gang ba bzang po ste thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po/ gcer bu dbang po 'phyang ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbur brgyan te/ de rnams kyis rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'o// sngags oṃ dzam+bhā la dza len+da ye swā hā/ oṃ ba su dha ṇ+yai swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ shrī dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa/ gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa// nor sbyin rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod do//

༈ /dgu pa dzam+bha la la chu sbyin pa'i man ngag gi rim pa mi 'dra ba gsum la lung rkyang ste de ltar rigs mthun phyogs gcig tu byas pas rjes gnang bdun yod pa yin no// ༈ (120)rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba nas gsungs pa'i slob dpon thogs med kyis zhal gzigs pa'i rje btsun byams pa ser po zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun byams pa mgon po sku mdog ser po zhal

man ngag la zhal gsum ga ser por snang ngo*/ gsum phyag bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal gur gum bzang po lta bu/ g.yas zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ g.yon zhal in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ g.yas 'og mas mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'og mas klu shing gi yal ga sngon po me tog ser po dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan dang zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ rin po che'i dpung rgyan dang*/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ gdu bu/ do shal/ ska rags/ se mo do yis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi smad g.yogs kyis mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag spyi/ sngags oṃ maiṃ mai trī ya swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ār+ya mai trī/ bstod pa/ byams chen me yis zhe sdang bud shing sreg /ye shes 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel// chos kyi rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa// dga' ldan bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// ༈ (121) /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i tham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis 'jigs byed mnan cing 'jigs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra/ bstod pa ni/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces so//

༈ (122) /srid pa'i khro bo stobs po che'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin rlabs rnams spyan drangs te tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid srid pa'i khro bo stobs po che sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dkar po dang rnga yab dkar po/ g.yon gnyis na phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ yan lag thams cad rab tu dmar ba/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ 'od zer dmar po'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ ma hā ba la swā hā/ mtshan sngags ma hā ba la/ bstod pa/ gang gi rang bzhin khro bral yang*// sogs so// ༈ (123) /bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi gdon bgegs thams cad nye bar zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid khro bo bgegs mthar byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ drag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che sna tshogs dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ āḥbighān ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dzā bighān ta kṛ ta/ bstod pa/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs so// ༈ (124) /khro bo'i 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi ste du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ rtsa zhal nag po khro zhing sgeg pa/ g.yas zhal drag po dkar ba/ g.yon zhal rnam par 'jigs pa sngon po/ rgyab zhal dpa' ba'i nyams can dmar ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas lhag ma gsum gyi ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon lhag ma gsum gyis gzhu/ zhags pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa/ me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas dbang phyug chen po'i mgo bo dang*/ g.yas bskums pas gau rī'i nu ma zung mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dzā hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags oṃ trai lo kya bi dza ya/ bstod pa spyi bstod bya'o// ༈ (125) /rdo rje me dang nyi ma ltar 'bar ba zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rdo rje me dang nyi ma ltar 'bar ba sku mdog mthing ga 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od zer can zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/

g.yas bzhi na rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na dril bu/ gzhu/ zhags pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ba dan sna tshogs dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra skya ba'i tshogs me 'bar ba/ shin tu 'jigs pa/ sbrul chen po 'khyil bas lag gdub dang*/ rked rgyan/ rkang gdub/ mgul rgyan/ rna rgyan/ cod pan du byas pa/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ 'jigs pa/ snying rje'i nyams dang ldan pa'i zhabs bzhi pa/ sgyu ma chen mo'i 'khor lor byas pa bzhi la chung ma dang bcas pa'i khyab 'jug gi steng na zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis mnan pa dbang du byed pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na lārka hūm̐/ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka/ bstod pa 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs so// ༈ (126) /rta mgrin gyi skor la dang po rta mgrin dmar po zhal gsum phyag brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ham̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag brgyad pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing bzhad pa/ g.yas zhal in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo zhing ljags 'dril ba/ g.yon zhabs gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar zhing mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ pad+ma kha 'byed pa'i tshul/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na sdigs mdzub/ rang gi nu ma g.yon pa/ pad+ma/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ khro bo'i lta stangs kyis zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ ha ya grī wa swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ ha ya grī wa/ bstod pa/ gang gi rang bzhin khro bral yang*// sogs so// ༈ (127)

/gnyis pa rtog pa bdun pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal rab tu dmar ba/ steng zhal sngo zhing 'jigs su rung ba ha ha'i sgra sgrogs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dbyug pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba can/ sbrul dang*/ klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi'u thung gi gzugs can/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ lha dang lha ma yin mtha' dag la bsdigs par mdzad pa/ zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ ha ya grī wa hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa snga ma dang 'dra'o// ༈ (128) /gsum pa rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyi ma'i rta mgrin gtso 'khor lnga pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa'i dbus su hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal nag po/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ steng zhal rta mgo ljang gu/ zhal mche ba rno zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ gsum pa gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs shing g.yon gnyis bskums pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ shar du hrīḥlas rta'i rdo rje ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/

dang po gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis kyis keng rus dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhor haṃ las phag mo nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis zhags pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'og ma gnyis kyis ker rus dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu hrīḥlas ce spyang rdo rje ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ḍa ma ru dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis keng rus dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ byang du lha mo dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa ste thams cad spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs shing 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'o// gtso 'khor rnams la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ ha ya grī wa hrīḥ.a ha a haṃ a haṃ ām̐ ām̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (129) /bzhi pa rta mchog dmar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas bdag nyid rta mchog sku mdog dmar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal khro zhing sgeg pa/ g.yas zhal drag po dkar ba/ g.yon zhal 'jigs su rung ba nag po/ steng zhal rta'i gdong pa ljang gu/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas bzhi na sna tshogs rdo rje/ ba dan gsum pa/ ral gri mda'/ g.yon bzhi na ral gri dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma/ mdung*/ dbyug pa/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi dang pos dbang mo dang sbrang rtsir byed pa/ gnyis pas rgyal bar byed pa dang bde spyod mnan pa/ g.yas bskums pa'i dang pos dbang po dang dpal mo/ gnyis pas 'dod lha dang 'dod lha'i chung ma mnan pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag spyi/ sngags oṃ sum+bhā ni sum+bha hūm̐/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ pa ra mā shwa/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (130) /gshin rje'i gshed nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/

stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa mthing nag 'phyar ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi'u thung lta bu lto ba 'phyang zhing ma he dmar po'i steng na zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ mche ba rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal can/ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa ya mā ri/ bstod pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes so// rjes gnang gi tshe de ltar na gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang gi lus kyis skye ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad sbyangs/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ de la brten nas gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku bsgom pa dang*/ sku'i phrin las mtha' dag bsgrub par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ gsung dang thugs la'ang des rigs 'gre zhing*/ gong 'og gi khro bo khro mo gzhan la'ang de bzhin du shes par bya'o// ༈ (131) /gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag zhal gsum pa'i sgrub thabs ni/

gzhan thams cad gong dang 'dra ba la/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku dang rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yas zhal dkar po/ g.yon zhal dmar po/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum na 'khor lo/ ral gri/ gtun shing*/ g.yon gsum na bet+ta lī ste gsal shing la btsugs pa'i ro/ dgra s+t+wa/ rdo rje zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa'o// ༈ (132) /gdong drug gi sgrub thabs ni/ pam̐ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ zhes pa nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog nag po zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug pa/ rtsa zhal brtsegs ma gnyis nag po/ g.yas zhal brtsegs ma gnyis dkar po/ g.yon zhal brtsegs ma gnyis dmar po/ zhal re re la dmar la bgrad pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ bar pa gnyis kyis tho ba dang zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang gtun shing 'dzin pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ bar pa gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang*/ tha ma gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams 'dra'o// ༈ (133) /phag mo'i skor la dang po rdo rje phag mo lha lnga'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi lhun po dang bcas pa'i steng du rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ mda'i drwa ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang ldan pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du paṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog sin+dhū ra'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dmar ba/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ skra grol ba/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ bha ga nas khra 'dzag pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā mā ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma dkar mo ste thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na ḍa ma ru dang*/ gri gug g.yon gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ thod pa 'dzin pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer bu zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ mtshams bzhir byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas kha bcad pa/ rigs bdag spyi/ sngags oṃ badz+ra be ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma// zhes so// ༈ (134) /gnyis pa phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs gnyis ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po dang a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin rlabs dang gzungs dang spobs pa la sogs pa 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa ba dan gsum dang ldan pa'i 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa'i zur phud gsum bcings shing skra grol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba dang*/ me tog sna tshogs kyis rnam par mdzes pa/ g.yon pa'i gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la thod pa skam rlon/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ bum pa/ dril bu/ ba dan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ gcer bu zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ sprul pa sna tshogs pa 'phro ba/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ wā rā hī badz+ra yo gi/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /gsum pa rdo rje phag mo dbang du byed pa'i cho ga la lung rkyang las rjes gnang mi dgos so// ༈ (135) /bzhi pa rdo rje phag mo'i rtog pa don thams cad grub pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las lte ba'i dbus su raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su hrīḥlas 'od zer zhes pa nas rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ gcer bu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing khro gnyer bsdus shing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yi dwags kyi gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ shar du rdo rje rta rna ma/ lhor shin tu 'jigs byed ma/ nub tu lto chen ma/ byang du ljags bskyod ma/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa'o// rigs bdag spyi/ sngags/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī ā be sha ya sarba duṣ+ṭan hrīṃḥswā hā/

zhes pa dang*/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ hrīṃḥhrīṃḥ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ (136) /gshed dmar yab yum gyi sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ ma he dmar po'i steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥsogs so// mtshan sngags oṃ shrī rak+ta ya mā ri/ bstod pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs so// ༈ (137) /kyai rdo rje'i rtsa bshad nas gsungs pa'i kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer zhes pa nas rang nyid dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'bar ba'i rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ba dan rtse gsum pas brgyan pa 'chang ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan kyis brgyan pa/ mi lpags kyi na bza' mnabs shing*/ thal chen gyis lus la byugs pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// kyai yi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod do// ༈ (138) /kyai rdo rje yab yum ni/ sngags dang lha mi 'dra bas rjes gnang so sor dgos pa 'dra ste/ gong gi des chog par mdzad do// ༈ (139) /rdo rje bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du aṃ las 'od zer zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yo thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ bha ga wa tī badz+ra nai rāt+ma/ bstod pa/ 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas// bdag med rnal 'byor mar gyur gang*// phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin thub ma// sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar phyag 'tshal bstod// ces so// ༈ (140) /rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa'i khro bo 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs gnyis la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las dri ma med pa'i hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rdo rje'i pho brang ches shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hrīḥyig las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du aṃ yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dwangs shing ches gsal ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/

rā gdengs pa lte bar hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar 'byung po 'dul byed kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po mig gsum pa lag bzhi pa/ g.yas ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris shing*/ skra ser po'i thor tshugs can kha bub tu mnan pa ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ mtshan sngags oṃ bhū ta ḍa ma ra/ bstod pa/ dpal chen nam mkha'i mdog gi mdangs ldan zhing*// dus mtha'i sprin ltar hūm̐ sgra 'brug stong chem// 'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi klad 'gems pa'i// phyag na rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ (141) /gur nas bshad pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang de'i steng du mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/

tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid dpal rdo rje nag po chen po sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar nag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan pa/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sku lus thung zhing sbom la gzi brjid che ba/ zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ sngags oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ bstod pa/ hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' che// grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs mdzad pa// gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do// zhes so// ༈ (142) /mgon po mngon byung gi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang de'i dbus su mi ro ser po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid dpal rdo rje nag po chen po sku mdog nag po cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga cu'i do shal can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/

dpa' bo'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing 'od zer drag po 'phro ba/ rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ sngags/ oṃ āḥmaṃ haṃ raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje nag po che// zhing rnams skyong mdzad khyod la bstod// ces so// 'dir bla med kyi lha thun mong ma yin pa'i gshed dmar/ phag mo gsum/ he ru ka bdag med ma/ rdo rje nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa/ phyag bzhi pa rnams la mchod rdzas kyi snod kyang ye shes kyi ka pā lar bskyed/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ rdo rje dril bu bshams la/ gtor ma'ang sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis brlab bo// 'bul dus mgo thod kyi phyag rgya 'cha' ba sogs phyag len la mdzad pa yin no// gong du brjod pa'i lha de thams cad rgyud sde 'og ma gsum nas 'byung ba'i lha gtso che ba yin te/ gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag de'ang spyod rgyud kyi pra khog glang la brten pa yin zhing*/ gdong drug ni bla med du bkral ba dang*/ yo gar bkral ba gnyis las 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas/ 'o na rdo rje gur sogs bla med nas bshad pa'i lha 'dug pa snyam du rtog na/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin na rgyud sde de dang de nas bshad pa'i tshul dang mthun par cho ga sgrub dgos pas dogs spong byas pa yin la/ bla med kyi rgyud nas bshad kyang las rgyas pa'i lha thun mong ba de dag la cho ga spyi 'gro de nyid kyis chog go /zhes bdag gi 'dren mchog dam pas de skad gsung ngo*// ༈ /spyi don gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gso/ slob dpon gyis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i sogs nas shab+da swā hās byin gyis brlab/ lha so so'i mtshan sngags re re sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da rol chen gyis mchod/

lha so so'i bstod pas bstod/ 'dod don zhu/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba nas/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ gnas gsum bsrung ba/ bkra shis dang smon lam bya ba rnams gong du bshad pa ltar so so'i khyad chos rnams ma 'dres par mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bya'o// gong du bshad pa'i sgrub thabs de rnams kyi bsdus don tshigs su bcad pa ni/ dam tshig gsum bkod zung ldan no// thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rtse// 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrub thabs gzungs// sum cu so lnga'o 'jam dbyangs ni// sgrub thabs man ngag bzhi bcu gcig /mi g.yo mgon po'i sgrub thabs bzhi// sgrol ma'i sgrub gzungs sum cu lnga// lha mo tsun+da'i mngon rtogs gsum// 'od zer can ma'i sgrub gzungs ni// bcu drug ri khrod sgrub gzungs rtse// sher phyin la ni sgrub thabs dgu// rdo rje dbyangs can mngon rtogs klu// khro gnyer sgrub thabs bgrod pa'o// rig byed mngon rtogs bcu dgu'o// rnam rgyal sgrub gzungs yon tan te// gdugs kar tsa rtsi so 'brang rtse// rma bya stong chen gsang sngags 'dzin// bsil ba'i tshal lo grwa lnga'i mig /phyir zlog rgyal mtshan rtse mo ni// phyag gnyis ma dang phyag bzhi ma// gzhan gyis mi thub gan+dha'i thung*// lcags sgrog phyag drug phyag brgyad mig /nor rgyun sgrub gzungs drag po'o// byams pa'i mig dang hūm̐ mdzad stobs// bgegs mthar gsum rgyal me ltar 'bar// rta mgrin rig byed gshin rje'i mda'// phag mo dbang po gshed dmar ro// kyai rdor thabs shes bdag med bgrod// 'byung 'dul mig dang mgon po zla// mgon po phyag bzhi bse ru ste// nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni// sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rnam grangs so// rjes gnang dang 'brel sgrub thabs ni// nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod// rjes gnang mi dgos sgrub gzungs ni// dam tshig gsum bkod sgrub thabs gnyis// pad+ma'i phyag dang ma sha'i gzungs// shes 'phel cho ga yi ge gcig

/sgrol ma'i las sbyor dug sel gzungs// rig sngags chen mo 'od zer can// ri khrod rig byed ma'i man ngag /sgrub thabs zhes so man ngag rim// las la rab sbyor nor rgyun gzungs// phag mo dbang byed dzam+bha la'i// man ngag dang bcas bco brgyad do// zhes pa mkhas pa snga ma dang*// bdag gi bla ma'i phyag len ltar// brjed pas 'jigs nas bris pa yin// rjes gnang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs ni// nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi la// rjes gnang de ltar dgos bsams na// de ni mi dgos 'di rnams kyang*// lha dang sku mdog phyag mtshan sngags// de rnams gcig na mang po yang*// rjes gnang gcig gis chog par bzhed// lha dang sku mdog phyag mtshan ni// mi gcig na ni sngags gcig kyang*// rjes gnang so sor byed dgos te// gshed dmar dang ni dgra nag bzhin// de bzhin sngags kyang mi gcig na// lha dang sku mdog zhal phyag ni// gcig kyang rje gnang so sor dgos// spyan gzigs ha la gnyis ltar ram// sher phyin ser mo phyag gnyis ma// bzhin no rigs bdag rgyas 'debs ni// gtso bo rnams la rang rigs kyis// 'khor rnams gtso bo nyid kyis brgyan// rigs bdag dmigs bsal med pa dang*// the tshom za na rdor sems kyis// brgyan no sngags med rnams la ni// rang rang sa bon dag gis ni// byed pa phag mo dkar mo bzhin// de ltar thog ma'i dam tshig gsum// bkod dang gzungs kyi cho ga sogs// rnams la rjes gnang ji ltar byed// soms shig kha cig glegs bam 'dir// gang bzhugs dpe ni re re bzhin// rjes gnang byed do bdag gis ni// rjes gnang 'brel pa nyis brgya dang*// nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams la ni// rigs mthun bsdebs pa'i rjes gnang ni// thog mar thub pa rdo rje gdan// 'jig rten dbang phyug nyi shu dang*// 'jam dbyangs la ni nyer lnga'o// mi g.yo mgon po la ni gcig /rje btsun sgrol ma nyi shu gcig

/tsun+da la ni gcig pu'o// 'od zer can la rjes gnang drug /ri khrod lo ma gyon ma gnyis// shes phyin lnga dang dbyangs can lnga// khro gnyer zla dang rig byed drug /rnam rgyal zung dang gdugs kar zla// tsa rtsi kā dang sgyu drwa nas// sor 'brang rma bya chen mo dang*// stong chen rab 'joms gsang sngags 'dzin// bsil ba'i tshal dang grwa lnga nas// bshad pa'i lha mo lnga yi gnyis// phyir bzlog ma dang rgyal mtshan rtse// gnyis so gzhan gyis mi thub gcig /rdo rje gan+dha lcags sgrog gnyis// nor rgyun ma la rjes gnang bdun// byams pa'i gcig dang hūm̐ mdzad zla// stobs po che la bla ma'o//
